articles.title: Intracity_Sporting_Rivalry_in_Valēka
articles.snippet: '''[[Valēka]]''', the most populous city of the [[Kiravian Federacy]], is home to two teams that compete in the Federated Fieldball League, the highest level league for Kiravian-rules gridiron football (commonly called "fieldball"): The Valēka Metropolitans and the Valēka Emperors. As in any city hosting multiple professional sports teams in the same league, the sporting allegiances of Valēka residents are split between the two teams. However, in Valēka, rivalry between the two teams and their respective fanbases, termed the "Blues" (''Ávrikuya'', Emperors fans) and "Greens" (''Kérmikuya'', Metropolitans fans) after the colours of each team's uniforms, has developed into a unique and pervasive phenomenon of social division, manifesting itself in {{wp|segregation}}, political polarisation, and sometimes physical violence between fans of the opposing teams. '''Issyria''' is a [[Metaregion|region]] of [[Great Kirav]] located in the interior of the {{wp|island continent}}. The political-territorial metaregion of Issyria encompasses an organic, traditionally defined cultural region of the same name broadly synonymous with the [[Issyr River|Issyr River Valley]] and the wider Issyr watershed, as well as four neighbouring provinces held to fall outside of the Issyrian cultural region.

articles.title: Kibble_Affair
articles.snippet:
The '''Kibble Affair''' (Coscivian: ''Lasa Rudskúl''; Varshani: ''Qalzun Žut'') was an incident that occurred in July 2026 in the Nočmal Locality, Southern Division of the Kiravian occupation zone in League-Occupied Varshan (now located in [[Nechaxa]]). 

The [[Final War of the Deluge]] had wrought utter destruction on the infrastructure of Varshan, and the core institutions of its antebellum economy - slavery and a command-and-control state had been abolished. In this environment of uncertainty and physical insecurity, the resumption of large-scale productive activities and distribution networks lagged, inaugurating a massive famine known as the [[Drakrang]]. Many communities across the country therefore remained dependent on {{wp|food aid}} provided by the occupying powers and foreign {{wp|NGO}}s. '''Kikpari''' are a sub-sentient primate species native to the Kikpar Wastelands of central [[Sarpedon]]. They are known to be a distant relative of [[Sigma males]]. A small number of the species live in [[Kikpar]], a climate controlled geodesic dome at the [[International Nature Preserve]].

==Intelligence and Communication==
Like many lower primate species, Kikpari demonstrate a considerable degree of cognitive ability. They are able to use simple tools and understand rudimentary, concrete instructions with the aid of hand signals. articles.title: Kiravian_Marxist_philosophy
articles.snippet:
'''Kiravian Marxist philosophy''' (Coscivian: ''Kiravix Marxirisēx Vódakéna'') is the philosophy of {{wp|dialectical materialism}} as introduced to Kiravia in the late 1800s ''anno Domini'' and subsequently practiced in academic and political settings in Kiravia. Kiravian Marxist philosophy heavily informed the formulation of [[Kirosocialism|Kirosocialist ideology]] and enjoyed wide-reaching state sponsorship and influence during the rule of the [[Kiravian Union]]. Although doctrinnaire Marxist thought in universities and in mainstream politics largely fell by the wayside after the end of the Kirosocialist régime, it survives in pockets of Kiravian academia to the current day and has left a lasting legacy on the {{wp|social science}}s in Kiravia.

articles.snippet:
[[File%3AAnkh_(SVG)_blu.svg|330px|right]]'''Kiravian Sectarians''' is a broad term for Christian sects in Kiravia that are neither in communion with the the major apostolic churches ([[Catholic Church|Catholic]], Coscivian Orthodox, [[Insular Apostolic Church|Insular Apostolic]], and [sometimes, see below] Eastern Orthodox) nor of discernibly Protestant heritage. It encompasses a number of small and medium denominations, some of which emerged in separations from the larger apostolic churches and differ from them primarily in liturgy, culture, or comparatively minor points of doctrine, while others are born of {{wp|Bid‘ah|new theological and political movements}} or are rooted in ancient theological tendencies condemned as heretical by the ecumenical councils recognised by the major churches.

articles.title: Kiravian_literature
articles.snippet:
[[File:CoscivianLiterature.PNG|thumb]]
'''Kiravian literature''' (Kiravic: ''Kiravix véna'') is the body of written works written in Kiravia or by Kiravians. It is primarily located within the wider category of [[Coscivian civilisation#Literature|Coscivian literature]], and has influenced and been influenced by the literature of other cultures in [[Ixnay]]. Literature occupies a place of high importance in Kiravian culture.


==Scope and definitions==
Kiravian literature overlaps with but is distinct from several other categories of literature. Because the vast majority of Kiravian literature is written by members of the Coscivian-Kiravian majority in Cosco-Adratic languages (or other languages in the Coscivian sprachbund, like [[Kikik language|Kikik]]) and reflects the culture of [[Coscivian civilisation]], Kiravian literature is considered a subset of Coscivian literature, and foreign studies of Kiravian literature often include earlier Coscivian works written prior to the Coscivian

articles.title: Ksoīn_River
articles.snippet:
[[File:Danube in Romania.jpg|thumb|The Ksoīn fifty kilometres upriver from Kartika]]
The '''Ksoīn River''' is a river in southeastern [[Great Kirav]]. It rises in the northern [[Pelerin Mountains]] and empties into [[Thessapic Bay]] at the Dameron Estuary. Its course forms the boundary between the states of [[Hanoram]] and [[Province №7]], except where it bisects the [[District of Ksoīnvra|Ksoīnvra District]], named for the river, which contains the federal capital, [[Kartika]]. Kartika is the largest city on the river and was historically the uppermost point at which it was navigable.

articles.title: Kētka
articles.snippet:
'''Kētka''' (also ''Ketkua'', ''Ketkēa'') is a concept in many [[Coscivian culture|Coscivian cultures]] relating to an attitude. Though often translated as ''slack'', it is not considered to have a literal Ænglish equivalent.

''Kētka'' is less prominent in the culture of the [[Eshavian Coscivians|Eshavian Coscivians]] and [[Antaric Coscivians]].

Some scholars of {{wp|Industrial and organizational psychology|industrial psychology}} hypothesise that ''kētka'' has been a significant drag on Kiravian economic development in modern times, negatively impacting performance, efficiency, and innovation.

articles.title: Lawful_Commonwealth
articles.snippet:
[[File:Emperor Ĥ.png|thumb|Woodcut print of Emperor Ĥ the {{wp|Polyorchidism|Pentorchid}}]]
In Coscivian historiography, the '''Lawful Commonwealth''' (High Coscivian: ''Gxcasvix tóxuréaχita'', Kiravic Coscivian: ''Áldóriþísāv'') was the first incarnation of the [[Coscivian Empire]]. The foundations  of [[Coscivian law]] and  the metaëthnic identity of the [[Coscivian civilisation#People|Coscivian people]] are attributed to the Lawful Commonwealth.

The Lawful Commonwealth was, in essence, a {{wp|confederacy}} of tribal units (initially seven) that accepted the Four Laws and Four Precepts, pledged to defend one another from attack by tribes outside of the confederacy, and agreed to bring their disputes to the Emperor for arbitration instead of making war on one another. articles.title: List_of_Kiravian_news_outlets
articles.snippet:
A large, {{wp|multilingualism|multilingual}} country with a vibrant {{wp|civil society}} and fairly robust {{wp|freedom of the press}}, [[Kiravia]] hosts a thriving ecosystem of {{wp|news outlet}}s reaching local, regional, nationwide, and international audiences. Many news outlets in operation today are or evolved from {{wp|print media}} organisations established in the 19th and 20th centuries AD, while a growing number of others are native to television, radio, or the Internet.

==Ansalon General News==
The '''Ansalon General News''' (Kiravic: ''Ēvsidhansten Ansalosk'') is a daily blanket newspaper based in Ansalon, [[Valēka]]. articles.title: McDickus_family
articles.snippet:
The '''McDicki''' (Singular: "McDickus" - Kiravic: ''Mikdikuv'', Gaelic ''mac Diachus'') are a [[Kiravian]] military family with ancestral roots in the state of [[Ateranda]]. The McDickus family has an illustrious (albeit eccentric) history of service in the Kiravian armed forces, having fought in every major Kiravian armed conflict since the [[Continental War]], during which their patriarch Prickus McDickus was noted for being the only man in his company to survive the First Battle of the Swadesh, escaping a Draili prison camp, and single-handedly capturing a Draili stockade with a two-shot pistol and a shard of bottle glass.

The family's early origins are shrouded in mystery. Prickus, the first documented member of the family, listed his hometown as Āxaśuldor (English: "Dry Heaves"), Ateranda State at the time of his enlistment. articles.title: MetNet
articles.snippet:
[[File:Antiope à Moscou-Portail Tourisme.jpg|thumb]]
'''MetNet''' is an {{wp|Videotex|interactive videotex}} {{wp|online service}} that predates the modern {{wp|internet}} and continues to be used in parallel with it. Developed during the 21160s at the Metrea Institute for Public Networks in [[Mérosar]], MetNet was promoted by the state-owned telecommunications monopoly, which provided MetNet terminals to Metrean households at a low cost, establishing a large user base in that state. MetNet service would later expand into the other Farravonian states of [[Ilfenóra]], [[Argévia]], and [[Cascada]], as well as areas of the Western Highlands and [[Æonara]]. Although usage declined with the rise of more modern nationwide and transnational online networks, MetNet still registers around 10 million connexions monthly as of 21208.

articles.title: Methodism_in_Kiravia
articles.snippet:
[[File:Lake_Junaluska.jpg|thumb|The Methodist {{wp|camp meeting}} town of Dunn-Lekrév, [[Asperidan]].]]

'''Methodism in Kiravia''' is the largest denominational family among the country's {{wp|Protestant}} minority.

Isolated Protestant congregations adhering to Arminian theology appeared in Eshavian-speaking areas of Northeast Kirav not long after the Reformation had spread to northern Levantia, but their influence was limited and it is unclear how long they survived. The first successful Methodist mission in Kiravia was led by the [[Caergwynn|Caerish]] Rev. [Welshname ap Welshmynn] in western [[Etivéra]]. Other important centres of Methodist evangelism were the Sostórpalan Meadowlands in southern [[Hiterna]] and parts of the [[Great Kirav#Western_Highlands|Western Highlands]].

articles.title: Minor_Kiravian_Overseas_Possessions
articles.snippet:
The '''Minor Overseas Possessions of the [[Kiravian Federacy]]''' are those territories subject to Kiravian sovereignty that are of comparatively minor significance due to their small geographic size, small or nonexistant population, or low strategic value. "Minor Overseas Possession" is not a formal or official designation: Most of the territories included under the label have the same legal status as more important jurisdictions.

==Antarctic Ocean Colony==
The '''Antarctic Ocean Colony''' (Kiravic: ''Axerca Âsoatúlcax Páscá'') is, contrary to its name, not a chartered colony, but rather a dependency situated on a small group of islets in the "Antarctic Ocean" region of the Southern Ocean. The islands have a tundra climate bordering on subpolar oceanic and support a permanent population of 834. articles.title: Moose_cavalry_in_Kiravia
articles.snippet:
[[File:Moose-cavalry.jpg|thumb|A Northwest Territories militiaman and his steed]]

The use of '''moose as cavalry''' for mounted warfare has a long history in [[Kiravia]]. The Koskenkorvan Moose (''Alces meridiæ'') is known to frighten less easily and be more susceptible to direction than its cousins in Great Kirav or Levantia. Domesticated by ancient Cosco-Adratic peoples who settled across the {{wp|hemiboreal}} and boreal climatic belts of Great Kirav, it was used as a pack animal and later as a mount. 

Although it is not clear when moose were first used in combat, the presence of moose skeletons at burial sites alongside arrowheads and copper weaponry suggests that they were employed for such purposes at least as early as 7,500 years ago. The first known moose cavalry units in state service are believed to have been raised during the Second Empire. [[File:Wrightstown Octagonal Schoolhouse HABS Photo.jpg|thumb|Kiravian one-room schoolhouses are typically octagonal in configuration.]]
[[File:DRYDEN DISTRICT SCHOOL NO. 5, TOMPKINS COUNTY.jpg|thumb]]
'''One-room schools''' (Coscivian: ''Þusêmraforśēm'') are commonplace throughout rural and remote areas of the [[Kiravian Federacy]], especially island, highland, deep inland, and high-latitude communities. They are typically used for primary education only, though some extend to the intermediate grade levels and a rare few serve secondary-school students.

Kiravian one-room schoolhouses are typically octagonal in configuration.

articles.title: Pelon
articles.snippet:
A '''''pelon''''' is a type of masque worn in some Coscivian societies, distinguished by a prominent beak that covers the wearer's nose and mouth. Although styles have changed over time and the popularity of the ''pelon'' has waxed and waned, the mask has never completely fallen out of vogue. 

[[File:Plague doctors' beak shaped mask.png|thumb|Woodcut of a man wearing a ''pelon'']]

The ''pelon'' has ancient roots in Coscivian culture, originating from folk costumes crafted by many tribes that emulated the appearance of birds from their local ecosystems and worn for ritual purposes and as tribal identity markers and status symbols. The early ''pelon'' also served a practical purpose, protecting the face from the wind and rain. Beginning in the 19th century AD, {{wp|oilskin}} ''pelon'' specifically for wear in nautical environments and rainy weather were manufactured. '''Prime Executive''' ([[Kiravic Coscivian|Kiravic]]: ''Vèurovektur''; [[Cape Coscivian]]: ''Prirovektur'') is a title accorded by republican {{wp|head of government|heads of government}} in several countries and territories, mainly of [[Coscivian civilisation|Coscivian]] provenance.

There are currently two heads of government of [[League of Nations]] member states bearing the title of Prime Executive:

*[[Prime Executive of the Kiravian Federacy]]
*[[Prime Executive of the Cape]]

The title is also used by heads of government of [[Chappaqua]] and the [[Copacaban Republic]], both LoN non-members, and of the {{wp|associated state|associated states}} of [[Saint Kennera|St. Kennera]] and [[Pribraltar]].

On the subnational level, governors of the Kiravian states of [[Cascada]], [[Hanoram]] and [[Province №7]], and the [[Melian Isles]] officially hold the title of Prime Executive, though it has fallen into disuse in Cascada and is inconsistently used elsewhere.

articles.title: Ramśek
articles.snippet:
The '''Ramśek''' is a Kiravian social archetype of working- or lower-middle class "ethnic Coscivian"<ref>Coscivian ethnic subgroups other than the "general regional majority peoples" (e.g. [[Kir people|Kir]] in the Kirish Heartland, [[South Coscivians]] in [[South Kirav]]).</ref> men living in the traditional residential areas of major industrial and post-industrial cities in [[Great Kirav]]. It is similar to the [[Urcean]] archetype of the "neighborhood guy". The term comes from the Kiravic word ''[[Kiravian addressing system|ram]]'' ("city block"), with the derivational suffix ''-śek'', which is roughly analogous to the English ''-er'' / ''-ite'' / ''-nik''.

[[File:Ramśek.jpg|thumb|Couple a' ''ramśekya'' in [[Cities of Kiravia#Primóra|Primóra]].]]

articles.title: Schedule_of_Senior_Colonial_Tenures
articles.snippet:
The '''Schedule of Senior Colonial Tenures''' (Coscivian: ''Rolēden Axerkax Héśdiforóskya'') is a Kiravian [what would you even call this?] establishing guidelines for the selection, tenure, and compensation of persons appointed by the [[Prime Executive of the Kiravian Federacy]] to senior administrative posts in the Kiravian overseas colonies, most importantly colonial governors. Although it has no legal force and is not binding on the Prime Executive, Kiravian leaders have nonetheless adhered to it fairly reliably since its adoption, with some exceptions. The primary purposes of the Schedule are to discourage corruption with regard to pay and appointments, establish standards of qualification for appointees, and promote regularity with regard to tenure for offices not otherwise regulated by [[Fundamental Statute of the Kiravian Federacy|constitutional law]] or legislation.

articles.title: Settlement_Movement
articles.snippet: The '''Settlement Movement''' (Kiravic: ''Trebiktorléran'') is a modern social movement in [[Kiravia]] promoting {{wp|settler colonialism}} through the foundation of {{wp|intentional communities}} overseas, primarily in the [[Mid-Atrassic States]] and other areas in [[Crona]] or elsewhere under Kiravian control or influence. Settlements associated with the Settelment Movement are called '''Movement settlements''' (''Lératrebin'', ''Lérakopsin''). The movement comprises a number of different tendencies with different ideological inspirations for their colonial undertakings, which can include {{wp|Coscivian nationalism}} or related civilisational ideas, religious revivalist movements, [[disurbanism]], ethno-linguistic preservation, and [[Kirosocialism]], among others. articles.title: Amateur_radio_in_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
'''Amateur radio''' is a popular hobby in [[Metzetta]], particularly among the older generations. The first amateur radio license in Metzetta was granted in 1921 and the well-established regulations of the Metzettan Amateur Radio Union formed the basis for many of the recommendations made in the charter of the [[International League of Radio Amateurs]], which is itself based in [[Inyang]]. The MARU is overseen by the government's Ministry of Communication.
==History==
TBC[[File:ExampleQSO.png|thumb|Example QSL card featuring Metzettan callsigns.]]
== Licensing ==
License offered in Metzetta for radio amateurs include Novice, Intermediate, Advanced, Special and Experimental. For most citizens only the first three are desired. Novice license holders generally go on to acquire better licenses to access more bands and use higher outputs; at the novice level no more than 5 Watts can be used for broadcasting. This rises to 20W at Intermediate and 50W for Advanced. Experimental Licenses allow

One of the 3 oldest extant tribes from Metzetta along with the [[Ssuseol Clan|Ssuseol]] and [[Pyeolhae Clan|Pyeolhae]] clans, they maintain influence through strategically marrying into the imperial family and other high-ranking clans. articles.title: Automotive_Industry_in_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
The automotive industry is a major employer in [[Metzetta]] and accounts for nearly 10% of the country's export market. The majority of the activity in the sector is centred in the city of [[Jamsu]]. Metzettan cars, buses, trucks and motorcycles are exported to many countries across the world.
== The Big Four ==
There are four major automobile manufacturers in Metzetta, sometimes nicknamed "The Big Four." They are;
* '''[[Hyansae Motors]]''', the oldest of the Metzettan car manufacturers. Hyansae manufacture both cars and motorcycles and export to more countries than any other Metzettan brand. While their headquarters are located in [[Inyang]], their factories are mostly centred in and around Jamsu. Hyansae cars are popular in [[Daxia]].

articles.title: Chulcheo
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
'''Chulcheo''' (출처) is the indigenous religion of [[Metzetta]]. Chulcheo is polytheistic and is the traditionally accepted explanation for the origin of the universe and the human race in Metzetta. Deities are worshipped in the home but mostly at shrines staffed by Chulcheo priests, who act under the direction of the [[High Priest of Metzetta]]. The High Priest was traditionally one of the most influential figures in the nation but now holds a purely ceremonial position within the [[Government of Metzetta|government]]; the position of High Priest is usually inherited by one of the officeholder's sons. Chulcheo was formally separated from the state under [[Anru Daeku|Emperor Daeku]]. Despite being the most prevalent religion in Metzetta, aside from a few cults it is rarely practiced abroad. articles.title: Culture_of_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
The traditional '''culture of Metzetta''' is the shared cultural and historical heritage of the people and empire of [[Metzetta]]. As one of the world's oldest continuous cultures, Metzettans have passed down their traditional narratives in a variety of ways.
== Social order ==
=== Clans and stratification ===
''Main article: [[Clans of Metzetta]]''

Metzettan society has a well-defined aristocracy, and while movement into a higher economic class is perfectly possible, the prestige of belonging to a high-ranking clan cannot be bought. At the top of the hierarchy of clans is the imperial family; following them are the ancient [[Ssuseol Clan|Ssuseol]], [[Pyeolhae Clan|Pyeolhae]] and [[Apsu Clan|Apsu]] clans of the [[Iyagi-ingan]]; below them are the [[Kino Clan|Kino]], [[Haruka Clan|Haruka]], [[Migyung Clan|Migyung]], [[Zuzeonhwa Clan|Zuzeonhwa]] and [[Jaenan Clan|Jaenan]] clans of the [[Iyagi-segye]]. articles.title: Dalrae
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
'''Dalrae''' is one of the most important figures in the [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] religion of [[Chulcheo]]; she was the first human ever born, and was the mother of [[Yang-jo|Metzetta's first Emperor]]. Her parents were Ssaum (the God of war) and Hwajae (the goddess of love). Together with Byeol, the demigod of the stars, she had 111 children; this is the origin of the human race in Chulcheo. She is said to have lived for 151 years.
== Biography ==
Shortly after the birth of Yang, a bear is said to have threatened Dalrae's child; in response she slaughtered the bear and prepared a blanket for her baby from its hide.
== Children of Dalrae ==
Dalrae had 111 children. The Metzettans were canny about editing the identities of these children; very few were mentioned specifically in the [[Iyagi-seda]], so going forward an "unused" child was often used to explain where newly discovered countries had originated. articles.title: Emperor_of_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
The '''Emperor of Metzetta''' is the monarch and head of state of [[Metzetta]]. The title has supposedly existed since 2333 BC and has been passed down from generation to generation until today, though the early Emperors were almost certainly mythical figures. When a female holds the position of Emperor, she is known as Empress and a new Imperial Dynasty begins, named after her as the matriarch of the house. The Emperor/Empress is addressed as His/Her Imperial Majesty. The Emperor is considered to be the personification of Metzetta and the will of the Gods, and is the central figure around which all history and culture in the country inevitably revolves.
== History ==
As recounted in the [[Iyagi-seda]], the central text of [[Chulcheo]], [[Yang-jo]] was the first man, born to [[Byeol]], demigod of the stars, and [[Dalrae]], the first woman. Through them all people are supposedly descended from the Gods, but as the firstborn of their 111 children Yang received special t

articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:MetzettanFlagMedium.png|thumb|The flag of Metzetta.]]
The '''Flag of The Empire of Metzetta''', commonly referred to simply as the '''Metzettan Flag''' is the national flag of [[Metzetta]]. It consists of an indigo field with red stripes down either side, and a stylised magnolia blossom in the centre, with white petals and a central yellow circle. The indigo section in the middle forms a perfect square.

[[File:MetzettanIndigoField.png|thumb|Mesedan indigo field.]]
[[File:MetzettanOldFlag.png|thumb|Mesedan flag.]]

Soon after the Emperor decreed that a new flag featuring the magnolia blossom motif should be used. articles.snippet:

The '''Government of Metzetta''' is responsible for running the country of [[Metzetta]], and is headed by the [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]].
== Structure ==
The absolute head of state and government is the [[Emperor of Metzetta]], whose family fill many of the highest-ranking offices of government. The government consists of 18 ministries. articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:HanzeongRoad.jpg|thumb|Modern buildings in Hanzeong.]]
'''Hanzeong''' is the capital of [[Metzetta]], and the country's largest, most populous city. 9.5 million people live in the city, around 12% of the country's entire population. The metropolis sprawls over an area of more than 600 square miles.
== Etymology ==
[[File:Hanzeong Street.jpg|thumb|Night scene from Hanzeong.]]
Hanzeong roughly translates as Giant Fortress.
== History ==
Hanzeong is an ancient settlement, possibly one of the oldest in the country. It was said to have been founded by [[Yang-jo]] over 4000 years ago.

Hanzeong was originally surrounded entirely by the Fortress Wall of Hanzeong to provide its citizens with security from wild animals, thieves and attacks, but most of the original wall no longer stands; a short stretch and several original gates do survive today and are protected. articles.title: Hanzeong_1950_Summer_Games
articles.snippet:
The '''Hanzeong 1950 Summer Games''', also known as the '''First [[Istroyan Games]]''', were an international multi-sport competition held in [[Hanzeong]], [[Metzetta]], in August 1950. Hanzeong was chosen at random by the International Istroyan Games Committee to host the games in an effort to repair worldwide diplomatic relations following the conclusion of the Second Great War. At the time they were simply known as the Hanzeong 1950 Games but since the introduction of the Winter Games in 1976 they have been retroactively referred to as Summer Games. The Games were attended by Metzettan royalty including [[Anru Jan-Hu|Emperor Jan-Hu]].

The Istroyan Stadium was specially constructed in Hanzeong to host the opening and closing ceremonies as well as athletics, tug-of-war and archery events. articles.title: High_Priest_of_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
The '''High Priest of [[Metzetta]]''' is the leader of the [[Chulcheo]] religion. Traditionally a high ranking [[Government of Metzetta|government]] official until the separation of state and religion under [[Anru Daeku|Emperor Daeku]]. Chulcheo priests are not restricted in having children and the position normally passes down through the generations; each High Priest is entitled to name his or her successor. Women can hold the position of High Priestess but are markedly less common than men. The first two High Priests were Emperors, the position was not separated from the monarch by default, though early High Priests are considered fictitious much like the early emperors. Their lineage is well documented thanks to the Metzettan obsession with [[Genealogy in Metzetta|genealogy]].

articles.snippet:
{{WIP}}
[[Category:IXWB]]
== Prehistory ==
Tool-making artefacts have been found in [[Metzetta]] dating from around 700,000 years ago. Settlements seem to have been concentrated in the central-western portion of the country. Agricultural societies and the most primitive forms of social-political complexities emerged around 1500 BC, developing around both dry-field and paddy-field crops. Beginning in 850 BC, chiefs began to take command over societies, and their (for the time) lavish burials have been excavated across the country. Bronze-production became possible in 700 BC and immediately cemented itself as a cornerstone of civilisation. Long distance trade, increasing levels of local conflict and the development of iron metallurgy signalled the end of this era of history about 300 BC.

articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:HyansaeLogo.png|thumb|Logo of Hyansae Motors.]]
'''Hyansae Motors''' is a [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] automotive manufacturer headquartered in [[Inyang]], with its main production facilities located in [[Jamsu]]. While predominantly known for its cars, Hyansae also produces motorcycles. They are the most well known Metzettan automobile brand internationally, and the most successful domestically. Hyansae exports a large quantity of vehicles to [[Daxia]]. Hyansae Motors was formed in 1943 by Hyansae Jaseon after the [[Second Great War]] came to an end.
==History==
Hyansae Jaseon was fascinated by cars and as a young man decided he would make Metzetta's finest automobiles, and began designing what would become the Type 1 in the 1930's. The Second Great War delayed his plans, however he was finally able to put his design into production in 1943.

articles.title: Iyagi-seda
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:IyagiSeda.jpg|thumb|A worn copy of the Iyagi-seda.]]
The Iyagi-Seda is the oldest extant book of classical [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] history, published in 740 BC. It begins with the Metzettan creation myth ([[Chulcheo]]) explaining the origin of the world. It goes on to recount several lesser myths and includes an extensive genealogy of the Metzettan Imperial Family. It describes episodes from Metzettan history and diplomatic contacts with other countries. Some obscure early [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperors]] are known only from the Iyagi-seda.

"Iyagi-seda" has been variously translated into English as "Fierce History" and "Origin of Power/Strength." Modern translations are usually released under the native name.

The writing of the Iyagi-seda began under Empress Kukki, and was completed under her successor Emperor Gwe.

It is located in [[Hanzeong|Hanzeong's]] Socheon District. The complex houses many buildings, including residences and [[Government of Metzetta|government]] offices, and is flanked by the [[Emperor's Gardens]].

1394.

'''Mettubok''' (literally "mountain clothes") is the traditional dress of [[Metzetta]]. The basic structure of mettubok consists of the ''jeogori'' jacket, ''baji'' pants, ''chima'' skirt, and the ''po'' coat; it was designed to facilitate easy movement. Metzettans wear the mettubok today for formal or semi-formal occasions and events such as festivals, celebrations, and ceremonies including weddings.

The '''MetzRail Class 4''' is a class of diesel-electric locomotive formerly operated in [[Metzetta]] by the publicly-owned [[MetzRail]]. A total of 204 were built between 1959 and 1963 by Galko Engine Works. They were the pride of Metzetta's diesel fleet upon their introduction, with regular service ending in 1990; as they slowly lost their position at the forefront of rail technology in the country they found use in freight and secondary passenger capacities. articles.snippet:

The '''Metzettan Won''' (symbol: ₩, code: MZW) is the official currency of [[Metzetta|The Empire of Metzetta]]. The monetary subunit of the Won is the Jeon; each Won is divided into 100 Jeon, however the Jeon is never used for everyday transactions, normally only appearing in foreign exchange rates and fuel prices. The currency is issued by The Bank of Metzetta, based in [[Hanzeong]], the country's capital city. The word won means "round," describing the shape of the coin. Coin collecting was once a popular hobby in Metzetta. Special coins are often minted for commemorative purposes.

articles.title: Metzi
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
'''Metzi''' is a language isolate, and the official language of [[Metzetta]]. It is a recognised minority language in [[Duamacia]]. Metzi is known to have one extinct relative, formerly spoken on the island of Choju between Metzetta and Duamacia, now referred to as Chojuese. Metzi is written using the unique hangul alphabet, which is not currently used for any languages outside of Metzetta. Metzettan Braille is also used to record the language for the visually impaired. The language is officially regulated by the [[Metzettan Ministry of Education|Metzettan Ministry of Education's]] Metzi Office. The word Metzi means "mountain poetry."
== History ==
Modern Metzi descends from Middle Metzi, which descends from Old Metzi, which in turn descends from Proto-Metzi.
== Classification ==

articles.title: PROSPER_Program
articles.snippet: The PROSPER Program is a program between [[Lucrecia]] and [[Cartadania]] standing for Partnership for Reciprocal Opportunities, Stability, and Economic Resilience. The program was proposed by Lucrecian president Matthias Torres in early 2019 and put into practice by both countries in mid 2020. The main goal of the program was to provide an easy route for Lucrecians to work abroad without having to go through the trouble of emigrating out of the country in order for the Lucrecian government to be able to generate more money from taxes on remittances. The program originally worked by training unkilled Lucrecian workers for im-demand trade skills such as welding or electrician work and them sending them over to other member countries on temporary work visas however the program has also expanded to allow people to get the work visa with no trade training in order to work overseas in sectors such as agriculture and construction. articles.title: Pillarisation_in_Lucrecia
articles.snippet:
'''Pillarisation in Lucrecia''' ({{wp|Galician language|Isurian}}: ''Pilarización''; [[Emeritan Pelaxian|Pelaxian]]: ''Pilarizacion'') is a sociopolitical phenomenon in [[Lucrecia]] in which the citizens are vertically separated into groups based on their political beliefs. There exists four of these so-called "pillars" in Lucrecian society: the conservatives, the socialists, the liberals, and the nationalists.

articles.snippet:
[[File:Svalbard seed vault.jpg|thumb|The entrance to the mostly-underground facility]]
The '''Polar World Archive''' (PWA) is a secure facility constructed by [[Metzetta]] on the continent of [[Australis]] adjacent to their research station there. While constructed and maintained by the [[Government of Metzetta|Metzettan government]], the facility is open and free for any nation to use. The facility comprises three sub-facilities; the Polar Seed Bank, the Global Memory Project and the World Literature Anthology. The facility began operation in 2004.
==Polar Seed Bank==
By far the most extensive of the 3 projects in terms of scale and required maintenance, the Polar Seed Bank aims to collect seeds from as many species of plant as possible to prevent extinction in case of natural disaster, disease, sabotage or mismanagement. '''Provinces''' ''(do)'' are the highest-level administrative divisions of [[Metzetta]]. Each province has their own culture and symbols, including flags, cuisine, provincial capital cities and so on. Every province is split into counties ''(gun)'' and each county is further divided into prefectures ''(hyeon)''; altogether Metzetta is composed of XX counties.

'''Gomssi''' (곰씨) has an area of 9650 square miles and a population of 200,000. It consists entirely of islands in the Metzettan Archipelago, numbering 10 main islands and countless smaller rocks. '''Ramyeonba''' (literally "Noodle Bar") is a [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] fast food chain founded in 1983 in [[Inyang]]. The company steadily grew nationally before opening locations internationally in 1997; while not the most popular fast food chain in Metzetta, it is the most popular Metzettan chain abroad. The company's headquarters remain in Inyang to this day. Their menu consists mostly of noodle dishes served in takeout containers with disposable chopsticks; little seating if any is provided inside locations, with the focus being takeaway orders. articles.title: Shaftonism
articles.snippet:
[[File:Cool S.svg|thumb|This is the symbol of Shaftonism. No one really knows why.]]

'''Shaftonism''' (High Coscivian: ''Sciavtoriseon'', Kiravic: ''Śavtorisēn'') is a school of thought and a philosophical, ethical, and cultural tradition that originated in ancient Coscivian history from the teachings of Shafto and was further cultivated by successive generations of thinkers, known as the ''trastrav'' ("reflectors"). Shaftonist ideas and practices became enormously influential during the Second Coscivian Empire, cementing Shaftonism as one of the defining themes of [[Coscivian civilisation]].

Mediæval and modern philosophers have drawn parallels between Shaftonism and both {{wp|stoicism|stoïcism}} and {{wp|process philosophy}}.

==Concepts==
*''Vódárihan'' - "the Thinking Man"
*''Ixtévirsa'' - "Higher order"
*''Aþnivirsa'' - "Proper order"
*''Xarbonara'' - "Continuity"
*''Valium'' - "Duty"
*''Uodhir'' - "Edification"

articles.title: Shorad_Hwo
articles.snippet:
The '''Shorad Hwo''' ''([[Metzi]]:쏘랃훠)'' are an ethnic group residing on the easternmost islands of the [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] archipelago. They have occupied their islands since antiquity but were slowly assimilated and colonised by the Metzettans. They have their own language, culture and religion though to certain extents these have been suppressed by the [[Government of Metzetta|Metzettan government]] at various points in history.

== Etymology ==

== History ==
The Shorad Hwo descended from mainland Metzettans and formed a civilisation based on farming, hunting, gathering and fishing. They were in active contact with the mainlanders and maintained a friendly relationship with the kingdom of [[Daekang]]. Eventually they found themselves left behind and were asked to pay tribute to the mainland in return for protection from outside invaders. articles.title: Soran_Akēvarin
articles.snippet:
'''Soran Akēvarin''' was a Kiravian labour leader, politican, writer, and educator. He is best known for being the only [[Kirosocialist Party|Kirosocialist]] Delegate to the [[Federal Stanora]] to vote against the constitutional reforms of 21146 that replaced the Kiravian Federal Republic with the [[Kiravian Union]]. Though little more than a footnote in mainstream Kiravian history, he is regarded as an icon by Kiravian social democrats and a founding figure of [[Kirosocial democracy]].

Akēvarin was born in [YEAR] in [[County Śavanon, Vôtaska]], as the second son of an ethnic Norborian Coscivian family with ancestral roots in [[Etivéra]]. Akēvarin's parents were smallholding farmers of modest means. He was largely self-educated past secondary school and worked at a paper mill. He became a leader in the Brotherhood of Pulp & Paper Workers and also held positions in the [[Pan-Kiravian Congress of Trade Unions|PKCTU]].

articles.title: Ssuseol_Clan
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:SsuseolEmblem.png|thumb|Emblem of the Ssuseol Clan.]]
The '''Ssuseol Clan''' are a powerful aristocratic family from [[Metzetta]] claiming descent from Ssuseol and Hissano, children of [[Dalrae]]. The Ssuseol Clan have prospered since ancient times, and have held influence over the Imperial Family since at least 700 AD. It is considered likely that the Ssuseol, [[Pyeolhae Clan|Pyeolhae]] and [[Apsu Clan|Apsu]] clans conspired together to strengthen their claims to power by writing their ancestors into the [[Iyagi-ingan]], a tactic later adopted again by the [[Kino Clan|Kino]], [[Haruka Clan|Haruka]], [[Migyung Clan|Migyung]] and [[Zuzeonhwa Clan|Zuzeonhwa]] clans when compiling the [[Iyagi-segye]]. The family's primary strategy for central influence was through the marrying of Ssuseol children into the Imperial Family, ensuring the next [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]] or Empress would owe loyalty to the clan.

articles.snippet:
[[File:Khrushovka.JPG|thumb]]

'''Tonic Vineyards''' (Kiravic Coscivian: ''Imbola-Fèmralana'', [[Low Coscivian]]: ''Ṃbola'') is an {{wp|urban slum}} located in a disused industrial area in the [[Valēka#Cantons|Aspihar]] canton of [[Valēka]], [[Kaviska]]. Since the 21201 evacuation and levelling of the Polanintuv Downs slum in [[Escarda]], Tonic Vineyards is reported to be the largest slum in [[Great Kirav]] by population. The name of the neighbourhood references the {{wp|Buckfast Tonic Wine|low-cost caffeinated tonic wine}} consumed by its inhabitants, discarded bottles of which are ubiquitous along the slum's streets, most of which have accrued a layer of crushed green bottle glass over their pavement.

articles.title: Urom
articles.snippet:
{{User:Kir/Template}}
[[File:Petroglyphs in Victorville.JPG|thumb|Rock art produced by the Wod͡ʒagat people, a critically endangered Urom tribe]]
'''''Urom''''' are a heterogeneous category of non-Coscivian peoples native to [[Great Kirav]], distinguished from the other non-Coscivian minorities of the island continent (termed “National Minorities”) by their {{wp|tribe|tribal mode of social organisation}}, historical ''umpéa'' status under Imperial law, lack of integration into mainstream Kiravian society, and special developmental concerns. Collectively, they represent 2.1% of the Kiravian population, around 15 million people.

Urom peoples, having many cultural characteristics in common with {{wp|indigenous peoples}} on other continents and beset with similar socio-economic and political challenges, are often included in [[Occidental]] discourse on {{wp|Indigenous rights|indigenous issues}}. articles.title: Xolkriśgir
articles.snippet:
'''Xolkriśgir''' (literally "colour fear" or "chromophobia") is a widespread superstition in many [[Coscivian]] cultures that {{wp|colour photography}} has damaging psychic or supernatural effects on its subjects. ''Xolkriśgir'' has created an enduring taboo against colour photography in [[Kiravia]] and, to a lesser extent, among Coscivian minorities in other parts of the world.

==History==
There have been intensive efforts in anthropology and deep philology to understand the cultural roots of ''xolkriśgir''. These have focused on topics such as the ethno-metaphysical significance of [[colour in Coscivian culture]], {{wp|Aniconism|aniconist}} movements and mores in Coscivian history, and the sinister associations of {{wp|mirrors}} in Coscivian mythology, folklore, and literature. While no fully explanatory theories have yet emerged from this research, it does begin to elucidate the sensitive cultural context surrounding colour photography.

articles.title: Yang-jo
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
'''Emperor Yang-jo''' (Great Yang or Yang the Great, 2353 BC - 2278 BC) was the legendary first [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]] of [[Metzetta]] according to the [[Iyagi-seda]]. He is said to have reigned for 55 years from 2333 BC to 2278 BC, and was descended from Byeol, the demigod of the stars, and [[Dalrae]], the first woman. In modern Metzetta, the day of his legendary ascension to the throne is celebrated as National Foundation Day. While Yang-jo is widely believed by international scholars and historians to be fictitious, stories of him may reflect actual events.
== Legendary Narrative ==
The period before Yang's ascension is known as the Age of Gods. Yang was the first man; the eldest of Byeol and Dalrae's 111 children.
== Marriage and Children ==
Yang married his younger sister Alemdaun. They had six children; [[Wa]], Hironi, Jindo, Hiriko, Choseo and Hanrae. Yang and Alemdaun had 16 grandchildren.

articles.snippet:
[[File:Territorial losses of Nasastan 1805-1886.png|thumb|Territorial losses of [[Nasastan]] 1805-1886|330px]]

The [[Nasastan|Nasastani]] '''Century of Degeneration''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Degenerćjódzienlat''), also known as the '''Century of Rot''' ([[Pomorskitong]]:  ''Niezjedzienlat''), the '''Century of Humiliation''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Njiskuženjedzienlat''), or the '''Nasastani Dark Ages''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Čarcaś'š z Nasamijejsk''), designates a prolonged period of political disintegration, social collapse, demographic stagnation, and foreign economic domination in Nasastan, conventionally dated from 1792 to 1937. The period is generally considered to begin with the [[Sonar Reaction]] following the death of [[Napoleon Ziółkowski]] in 1792 and to end with the [[Paramilitary Revolution]] of 1935-1937, which dismantled the warlord system that had dominated the country since the late 19th century.

articles.snippet:
[[File:Ogółkosmetyk'š storefront.png|thumb|300x300px|An ''Ogółkosmetyk'š'' cosmetic shop in the capital city of [[Slawiščabad]], displaying various domestic cosmetic brands.]]
The '''cosmetics industry in [[Nasastan]]''' is one of the country's largest luxury-goods industries and a major component of contemporary Nasastani cultural life. Although cosmetics existed in Nasastan for centuries, the industry remained comparatively modest until the mid-20th century. The [[Séotko Project|Projekt Séotko]] cultural program fundamentally altered this situation by establishing cuteness, deliberate personal presentation, and aesthetic warmth as central components of modern Nasastani identity. Today, cosmetics are regarded as an ordinary component of adult social life. Makeup is commonly worn outside the home by both women and men, although the techniques and features emphasized differ by gender. articles.title: Culture_of_Nasastan
articles.snippet:
The '''Culture of Nasastan''' is deeply rooted in its distinctive religion, [[Zmoric]], a faith practiced almost exclusively within the country and often regarded as an ethno-religion. It emerged in the aftermath of the [[Sarpic Crusades]] against the [[Qajar Dynasty]], alongside the founding of [[Jaitymjejsk]] and the development of its educational system. Core concepts such as [[Lakhe'žic]], the [[War against existence|War Against Existence]], and the Lunarian legal and cultural framework form the backbone of Nasastani culture.

Both Nasastanis and outsiders alike view this culture as highly particularist, fundamentally different in its social structures, standards, and way of life. The broader Lunarian cultural sphere, of which Nasastan is a part, is often considered a unique civilization in its own right. Historically and even today, Nasastani and Lunarian cultures have remained largely isolated from external influences, with only minor, possibly coincidental, similarities to [[Cul

articles.title: Danmaku
articles.snippet:
[[File:Danmaku Nasastan Flag.png|330px|thumb|Danmaku Sigil Flag of Nasastan]]
'''Danmaku''' was a traditional method of resolving disputes and conducting organized combat among noble families or other structured groups of [[Sarpic people|Sarps]] in [[Nasastan]], functioning much like a ritualized war game. In [[Pomorskitong]], coats of arms are called ''hjérb'', but unlike in many other cultures, they were not used as martial emblems. Instead, hjérb were primarily displayed on banners or as symbols representing a family’s domain and heritage, reserved for peaceful contexts rather than warfare.

Each family or organization maintained its own unique Danmaku sigil, which carried inscribed patterns and references to specific zmors believed to enhance the effectiveness of their particular fighting style. articles.title: Epunk
articles.snippet: '''Epunk''' is a music genre popular in [[Nasastan]] and a subgenre of punk rock that blends traditional punk elements with electronic instrumentation like synthesizers and drum machines. It's known for its fast-paced, aggressive sound, distorted vocals, heavy basslines, and catchy hooks. Lyrically, epunk often explores social and political issues, frequently drawing from the poems, letters, and diaries of mentally ill individuals from the era of the Aristocratic Sovereignty of Nasastan, a progressive, neoliberal republic that began to collapse around turn of the 20th century. Though rock music didn’t exist during that time, many people coped with the mass mental health crisis by writing melancholic, often rhymed texts reflecting on personal suffering, unfulfilled love, and societal decay. articles.title: Lakhe'žic
articles.snippet:
'''Lakhe'žic''' is a cultural concept in Nasastani society that redefines how life and progress are understood. Rather than measuring individual or social advancement through productivity, efficiency, connection to nature, or ideals like degrowth, Lakhe'žic centers on convenience, contentment, and the minimization of suffering for the average person. It promotes the pursuit of ease and collective well-being through any means, whether technological, social, or philosophical. The word Lakhe'žic comes from [[Pomorskitong]], combining the words for “easy” and “life,” with the apostrophe symbol (‘) marking "easy" as a descriptive attribute of life. In this worldview, material wealth and personal success are not seen as inherently valuable, owning too many things is often regarded as a hassle rather than a sign of status.

Simple communal living is common among Nasastanis, not because it’s seen as morally superior, but because it’s simply the most convenient. It minimizes effort and stress.

articles.title: Mass_surveillance_in_Nasastan
articles.snippet: '''Mass surveillance in Nasastan''' refers to the large-scale collection, retention, processing and administrative use of information concerning the population of [[Nasastan]] by state institutions and associated organizations. Although surveillance practices existed in rudimentary forms before the establishment of the modern system, mass surveillance is generally considered to have begun ''de facto'' in 1951 and to have become institutionalized during the late 1950s and 1960s. The contemporary Nasastani system differs substantially from conventional secret-police models. Whereas surveillance during the early 1950s was principally directed against political opponents and groups regarded as threats to the state, the post-1950s system increasingly treated information as an administrative resource. = Defense Policy of Paulastra =

== Overview ==
The defense policy of the Imperial Kingdom of Paulastra is designed to ensure national security, uphold sovereignty, and maintain the free flow of trade and commerce. This policy accommodates the nation's historical context, diverse cultural influences, and the complexities of Southern Crona's geopolitical landscape.

== Key Principles ==
* '''National Sovereignty''': Protecting Paulastra's territorial integrity.
* '''Regional Stability''': Promoting peace in Southern Crona.
* '''Balanced Force Projection''': Maintaining versatile capabilities across all military branches.
* '''Strategic Partnerships''': Forming alliances and collaborating with international partners.
* '''Technological Advancement''': Investing in cutting-edge defense technologies.
* '''Asymmetrical Warfare Readiness''': Preparing for non-conventional warfare.
* '''Free Flow of Commerce''': Safeguarding crucial trade routes.

The '''General Diploma''' is a [[Qualifications and Standards Committee (Olmeria)|QSC]] certified Level 3 academic qualification in [[Olmeria]] that allows students to specialise in a number of subjects before attending Háskóli (University), entering the workforce, or pursuing other further education. It has been used in the country since educational reforms in 2027 abolished the preceding Olmerian Higher Educational Certificates (colloquially known as Olmerian Highers, or OHECs), and replaced them with the current non-linear system containing the General Diploma.

The General Diploma is usually studied and sat between the ages of 16 and 18 at state run Hövdsköle, in years 12 and 13, although there is no age limit on the qualification and the exams can be sat privately at a number of exam centers. The examinations take place over a 7 week period in May/June, towards the end of the Olmerian academic year.

articles.title: Haasta_Disaster
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
The '''Haasta Disaster''' was a serious incidence of football hooliganism and violence in Neuvesto, Olmeria. The incident occurred at the conclusion of the second leg of the 1926 Haasta Cup semi-final between amateur teams [[Jørpedal FK]] and [[Aletv Samfet FK]], as a result of unexpected crowd sizes and insufficient police presence. One fan was killed and over 500 people injured It remains one of the worst instances of footballing violence in Olmerian history, and influenced the introduction of more stringent club regulation, and later the creation and rules of the Olmerian Football Leagues.

== Background ==

=== Amateur Football in the 1920's ===
In the early 20th century, Olmerian football was highly fragmented, with no unified national competitions. Amateur and professional teams competed in a patchwork of regional tournaments, with many teams struggling to gain recognition outside their local communities. Amateur football, in particular, was deeply rooted in local culture

articles.snippet:
Imperial Cola Symphony by Maria Petrovna
==Background==
Maria Petrovna, a renowned Paulastran poet, penned "Imperial Cola Symphony" as an ode to the ubiquitous Imperial Cola—a soft drink that has come to symbolize more than just a beverage in Paulastra. The poem was written in 2012 and quickly gained national attention, turning into something of a cultural meme. This work explores the drink as a metaphor for Paulastran identity, unity, and everyday life.
 
==Structure==
The poem is divided into four stanzas, each focusing on a different aspect of Imperial Cola's significance in Paulastran society. It employs a mix of traditional and free verse forms, allowing the poem to have both rhythmic flow and modern appeal. Given the high literacy rate in Paulastra, the poem was quickly analyzed and discussed in various academic circles, adding multiple layers of interpretation to what appears to be a straightforward subject.

While the lower regions of the mountain's foothills are a popular tourist site, few venture up the mountain in earnest. In fact, no-one has yet summited the peak, although 608 people have officially tried, with 54 of them dying in the attempt. articles.title: Nasastani_Recordkeeping
articles.snippet:
The practices of '''recordkeeping in [[Nasastan]]''' form a long and uneven continuum shaped by shifting regimes, religious traditions, and varying levels of administrative sophistication. Sources range from scattered [[w:Archaeology|archeological]] remains to highly stylized [[w:Theology|zmorological]] chronicles to modern bureaucratic documentation. Scholars often divide Nasastani historiographical material into several major eras, each defined by its own methods of preserving information and each marked by gaps that make the construction of a continuous historical narrative somewhat messy.

== Prehistory ==
Evidence for the prehistoric period rests entirely on material findings, excavated [[w:Stratum|strata]], and environmental analysis. [[File:Nasastani Nation Group Map.png|250px|thumb|The Nasastani Nation Group (in Green) and Ethnic Minorities (in Red) in [[Nasastan]]]]

The '''Nasastani Nation Group''' is an ethnonationalist and pan-nationalist concept that defines the collective existence of the peoples of [[Nasastan]]. It is rooted in the theory of [[Universal Nationalism|universal nationalism]], a principle central to Nasastani governance and politics, which holds that every state should either function as a nation-state or at least grant cultural autonomy to constituent nations within a broader cross-national framework of closely related groups. The Nasastani Nation Group embodies this idea of a "cross-national framework of similar nations." Within Nasastan, the krai system ensures that each recognized nation maintains its cultural autonomy and protects its national uniqueness, while remaining integrated into the larger national federation. articles.snippet:
{{wip}}

'''Potatogate,''' also known as the '''The Canespa Affair''', and '''The Olmeria-Canespa Collusion Scandal''', was a diplomatic and political scandal regarding the continuation Olmeria's economic and diplomatic relations with [[Canespa]] by then president [[Kiel Frieden]], despite international condemnation of Canespan actions. It was further developed by public threats of Canespan interference in Olmerian elections in favour of the then pro-Canespa Unity Coalition. The scandal was the leading cause of the [[2034 Olmerian Political Crisis]], which saw the biggest political upheaval in [[Olmeria]] since the start of the 21st century.  

== Names and Origin ==
The scandal was widely dubbed ''Potatogate'' by Olmerian journalists, in reference to the main industry of Canespa. articles.title: Qajar_Collapse
articles.snippet:
The '''Qajar collapse''' refers to the decade-long decline and fragmentation of the [[Qajar dynasty|Qajar Dynasty]] following the end of the [[Second Qajar-Istroyan war|Second Qajar–Istroyan War]] in 1433. The collapse is generally understood as a process rather than a single conflict, marked by overlapping regional rebellions, loss of administrative cohesion, and the reorientation of political authority among various local powers. The collapse resulted in the end of meaningful centralized rule and the partition of Qajar territory among new states and regional polities starting what is known as the [[Citian Period]].

The roots of the collapse lay in the failure of the dynasty to manage internal social divisions that had formed over the fourteenth and early fifteenth centuries. The [[Persio-Sarps|Sarps]], the [[Persian Highlanders|Persian Highlander]] clans, merchant guilds in the southern cities, and the landholding nobility all held distinct identities and expectations. articles.title: Real_estate_in_Nasastan
articles.snippet:
[[File:Housing area within suburban Dlugwodmasto.png|thumb|Housing district in suburban [[Dlugwodmasto]], photographed in 2040.|500x500px]]
'''Real estate in Nasastan''' refers to the ownership, management, inheritance, and allocation of housing and property within the [[Nasastan|National Federation of Nasastan]]. Unlike most contemporary market economies, the Nasastani real estate system is heavily regulated and operates according to the principles of [[Pragmatic Economics]], a doctrine emphasizing the efficient use of tangible resources over speculative financial activity. Property ownership is restricted through a nationwide [[Własnośćpónky|point allocation system]], inheritance is heavily limited, and housing policy is closely integrated with demographic and social objectives. The '''Rota System''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Rotacéa'', lit. "Rotation") was the electoral succession system used by the [[Grand Duchy of Nasastan]] and later the [[Kingdom of Nasastan]] between 1722 and 1832. Under the system, the reigning monarch was not automatically succeeded by his eldest son. Instead, upon the death of a Grand Duke or King, members of the Uprawa assembled to elect a new ruler from among eligible members of the [[Ziółkowski dynasty]]. Originally established as a compromise between dynastic legitimacy and [[Kallistocracy|Kallistocratic]] distrust of hereditary entitlement, the Rota System became one of the defining institutions of 18th century Nasastan. articles.snippet:
In recognition of the trials we have faced, in acknowledgment of our diverse culture, and in hope for the future we might share, this, the Second Constitution of Olmeria, is hereby established. With this we ensure that all the people of this nation shall be equals in opportunity, shall have fair voice in governance and shall be treated justly by all. It is with this commitment that we embark on the creation of a new, free Olmerian state that may serve us all with dignity.

=== Chapter 1: Rights and Principles ===
Protecting the rights of the Olmerian people, and all people who set foot on the isle of Tarsa, must be the states first and foremost priority. The chapter here inscribed entrenches those absolute rights, essential in any free nation, in a higher law, such that no government may infringe on them, and they may be upheld most strongly by the courts of law.

articles.title: Sins_of_Zmoric
articles.snippet: The '''Sins of Zmoric''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Śud Bezpowróob'š'', "Seven Pointless Tasks") are a set of seven moral prohibitions within [[Zmoric]], a syncretic religious tradition originating in the early 14th century. They constitute one of the earliest and most foundational elements of Zmoriite ethical thought, emerging during the formative period described in the [[Aliajasatan]] (1310s–1320s), a key manuscript documenting the teachings and lives of the first Saint-Brewers. The seven sins are Greed, Pride, Wrath, Gluttony, Mischief, Lust, and Stratification. While structurally derived from the Christian concept of the [[w:seven deadly sins|seven deadly sins]], they were substantially reinterpreted, redefined, and in part replaced within a distinct theological and social framework. In Zmoric, the sins are not primarily understood as transgressions against a divine or morally perfect authority, but rather as actions which produce unnecessary or unjustified suffering in others, especial

articles.title: Society_of_Nasastan
articles.snippet: The '''society of [[Nasastan]]''' is characterized by its [[w:Communitarianism|collectivist ethos]], pragmatic moral philosophy, and rejection of [[w:Materialism|materialist]] and [[w:Individualism|individualist]] value systems. Rooted in the [[Lakhe'žic]] tradition, which prioritizes convenience, ease, and the minimization of suffering, Nasastanis organize their social and political life around cooperation, mutual dependence, and a [[w:Utilitarianism|utilitarian]] sense of harmony. The state and people alike view individuality as an evolutionary regression, while codependence and shared well-being are seen as both moral and practical necessities. Distinct from most global societies, Nasastan does not glorify life for its own sake nor value struggle as a sign of virtue. '''Statistic Missing''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Statestéka ńetrafal'') was a peculiar and iconic message that began appearing on the early Nasastani internet during the late 1990s and early 2000s. Unlike standard error messages such as “N/A,” “404,” or “Data Not Found,” the Nasastani government implemented a more culturally distinctive placeholder. Instead of a technical notice, users were met with a bright red text reading '''Statestéka ńetrafal''' followed by a smiling face emoji. It was first used on the official government statistics portal, as a temporary placeholder for missing census or economic data, but it quickly took on a life of its own. The message gained widespread attention in 2003, when a population report on GDP per capita showed nothing but rows of smiley faces. The '''Triade System''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Triada'') was the social, political, and legal order of the [[Grand Duchy of Nasastan]] between 1704 and 1783. It divided society into three officially recognized estates, the ''Uprawa'', ''Pospolite'', and ''Pozamnąur'', each associated with specific ethnic communities, political responsibilities, military obligations, and legal privileges. Although frequently described as a caste system by both contemporaries and modern observers, the Triada occupied an ambiguous position between a caste system, an estate system, and a uniquely Nasastani form of feudal organization. The system originated during the reign of Grand Duke [[Majciš Ziółkowski]] following the overthrow of the [[Neo-Caliphate|Oduniyyad Neo-Caliphate]]. articles.title: Unßißtne
articles.snippet:
'''Unßißtne''' refers to the act of sharing a room with others for an extended period of time, without planning an activity or conversation, simply existing together. It is considered a form of [[w:Intimate relationship|intimacy]] in [[Culture of Nasastan|Nasastani culture]]. The word comes from the phrase ''unß ißtne'', meaning joint existence in [[Pomorskitong]], which reflects the idea that presence itself can be meaningful. It is something that happens naturally when people who are already close feel no need to entertain each other.

Although unßißtne can arise spontaneously, it often happens in third spaces. These are communal rooms used by clubs, friendship groups, or neighborhood circles. The atmosphere is calm and familiar. People sit in different parts of the room, sometimes near each other, sometimes apart, but always within the same shared environment. Conversation is minimal and gentle. '''Zmory''' (singular '''Zmor''') are supernatural entities in [[Zmoric]], a syncretic religious tradition originating in 14th-century [[Nasastan]]. They are believed to inhabit a metaphysical plane distinct from the material world and act as intermediaries between humans and the divine. Zmory are associated with visions, altered perception, and spiritual experiences, particularly those induced through the ritual consumption of alcohol, which is regarded as a conduit for spiritual communion.

articles.title: Abioic_polities
articles.snippet:
{{Template:History of Tierrador sidebar}}

The '''Abioic polities''' were a series of political entities that largely encompassed the [[South Crona|South Cronan peninsula]] that aligned with the [[Abioic civilization|Abioic tribes]] that were able to establish polities to convey their influence to other settlements. Two types of polities existed throughout the Ancient Abioic era, consisting of a city-state, which typically consisted of thousands of tribesmen living in a small land area, often building large cities; along with lands, which consisted of small settlements or villages, and had nomadic tribes that spread to cover large amounts of land. The two types of polities were random, with city-states and lands being established since the end of the southern migrations. The end of the 2nd century BC in modern-day [[Tierrador]] was the peak of independent city-states and nations, with the city-states establishing an early supply system through trade agreements with nations, transportin

articles.title: Abioic_supply_chain
articles.snippet:
A '''Abioic supply chain'''  ({{lang-qa|ᐦᐰᓱᓇᓥᑭᓂ, Hpaaisonalwookini}}) is a complex network of manufacturing, logistics, warehousing, retail, and their transportation systems that serve the majority of [[South Crona]], known as the [[Abioic civilization|Abioic world]]. It enables the movements of various different goods and services across the region, with the majority of the chain being controlled by [[Tierrador]], of which it provides commercial support for its [[Tierrosphere|periphery sphere of influence]], which consists of [[Ceylonia]], [[Porlos]], [[Atapakona]], [[Istrenya]], and parts of [[Peratra]] through Tierradorian colonial holdings in [[Teschego]].

The first instances of a supply chain occurred around the midpoints of the [[Qabóri Woqalate]], as the [[Qangreč]] had ruled in favor of standardized trading around its territorial peak throughout the 13–14th centuries. articles.title: Abortion_in_Puertego
articles.snippet:
Puertego has some of the strictest laws and regulations in Sarpedon with abortion only allowed in Puertego if there is complete certainty the mother would die from having the child with laws existing to illegalize abortion in Puertego since the early 1920's. In Puertego anyone who performs an abortion can be charged with murder with a mandatory death sentence if the abortion was done without the victim's consent, the recipient of the abortion faces a prison sentence of up to 12 years unless the abortion was performed on her without her consent.

Abortion laws in Puertego first date back to 1924 with the practice being completely illegal under the law regardless of any circumstances with the laws staying in place even under the constant regime change of the country with there having been several cases of women being arrested and tried for getting illegal abortions when it was later proven that they had natural miscarriages or stillbirths. in the late 1980's until the early 2

articles.title: Administrative_divisions_of_Tierrador
articles.snippet: The '''Administrative divisions of Tierrador''' are the subnational administrative units in the [[Tierrador|Tierradorian Woqalate]]; they are composed of a nested hierarchy of administrative units. There are three major categories of Tierradorian administrative divisions as recognized by the Revised Woqalate Charter of 1874. The highest level of these administrative units are ''commonwealths'', of which there are 18. The commonwealths are further divided into First-Level Divisions, which there are 43 in total. Qoyalets are strictly ceremonial, and while they do have a provincial capital and are used by some government agencies, republics and kingdoms possess more autonomous power, due to their history as strictly tribal lands. First-Level Divisions are further divided into ''counties''<ref>Referred to as parishes in the republics and the Kingdom of Bogocía</ref>, of which there are 950. articles.title: Agriculture_in_Tierrador
articles.snippet: Agriculture is the third-largest industry in [[Tierrador]], and it is a next exporter of many different foods. As of 2035, agriculture uses 42% of the country's land area, employs 9% of its workforce, and makes up 11% of the country's [[w:Gross domestic product|gross domestic product]]. Currently, there are approximately 2,866,402 registered farms in Tierrador, which cover a total of 526,702,720 acres, or 822,973 square miles, with an average of 183.75 acres per farm. Tierrador produces 95% of its domestic food consumption, and farming is a highly-respected career in the [[Abioic civilization]]. '''Agriculture in Tierrador''' is highly-mechanized, with the term "neo-agrarian" being used loosely to describe the country and surrounding areas. Because of this, an average of one farmer is required per farmstead for efficient agricultural production. articles.title: Bajablastra
articles.snippet:
[[File:BajablastraLocator.png|thumb|Bajablastra as part of the Jusonia Islands.]]
'''Bajablastra''' is the smallest of the [[Jusonia Islands]].

Formally established as a clandestine port and settlement by Coscivian corsair captains seeking refuge from the prying eyes of imperial navies, the island quickly burgeoned into a bustling hub of illicit trade. Its strategic location, nestled amidst the labyrinthine archipelago of the Jusonian Islands, afforded these seafaring renegades a haven from which to launch raids and plunder unsuspecting merchant vessels traversing the Kindred Sea.

The people of Bajablastra have a homogenised admixture of Pelaxian, Loa, and [[Conaterra]]n ancestry, and speak Loapu Creole, a Maritime Loa-based creole on a Loa grammatical base with heavy Pelaxian influence.

The island is most famous as the sole producer of a brilliant teal stimulant beverage known locally as ''basata'' but marketed abroad as ''Bajablastra'', named for the island itself.

articles.title: Chess_in_Thervala
articles.snippet:
[[:en:Chess|Chess]] has been played in Thervala since the third century BCE. It was introduced to the Ther people during Arunidization and is colloquially known as "The Great Equalizer" in Ther society, '''มหาสมาน''' (''Mahā Samān).'' This is due to the fact that it is a universal pastime that transcends class, ethnicity, and religious affiliation. Chess is so ubiquitous in Thervala that it has more Grandmasters per capita than any nation in the world. 

Early Ther society was eager to adopt chess due to its association with the ruling Arunid castes, so much so that it remained a staple long after the Arunids were deposed. Over the course of two thousand years, chess has ingrained itself into Ther social and political institutions alongside [[Muay Ther]]. Proficiency in either chess or Muay Ther is traditionally considered a prerequisite for holding positions of political leadership, with candidates expected to attain at least an intermediate rank in one of the two disciplines.

articles.title: Christianity_in_Thervala
articles.snippet:
{{WIP}}
'''Christianity''' was first introduced to [[Thervala]] by [[Levantia|Levantine]] and [[Burgundie|Burgogniac]] missionaries and intellectuals. Both Protestant and Catholic forms of Christianity have proven to be very syncretic with Ther society. As such, a 2030 census shows that the 35% of the population identifies themselves as Christian. Further polls show that it is split 17% [[Catholicism|Catholic]] to 18% [[Mercantile Reform Protestantism|Mercantile Reform Protestant]]. Geographically, Christians in Thervala are predominately located in its largest cities with some Catholic representation in the provinces. Usually with at least one large Cathedral per province. Mercantile Reform Protestants seem to be exclusively located in large urban areas.

articles.title: Giant_Loa_Salamander
articles.snippet:
The '''Giant Loa Salamander''' (''Caudaeassa loagemma''), called ''Sena'a'' is a species of giant salamander native to [[Takatta Loa]]. They grow approximately 230 centimeters in length but become sexually mature at around 90 centimeters. They are very long lived but reproduce quickly, often having many offspring that fail to reach adulthood. They typically reach full size after 10 years but reach sexual maturity in four years. The salamanders live in the rivers of mainland Takatta Loa which often have low visibility and low oxygen, which has led to the adaptations of elecro-sensory organs and large skinfolds to absorb more oxygen from their surroundings. They feed primarily on small fish and crustaceans which live in abundance in riverine Takatta Loa.

Puertego's history of nuclear accidents is solely based on an accident involving the government of Puertego losing 10 large ballistic missiles carrying nuclear warheads, the weapons that were placed in the country were largely placed in the country during the late 1970's and early 1980's. The Puertegan government started an investigation on the location of the weapons in 2002 a few weeks after it was discovered the nuclear weapons were missing, the investigation lasted until 2022 where it was ended, afterwards the government of Puertego offered the equivalent of $50,000 in exchange for information on the location of the nuclear weapons.

articles.title: History_of_Pelaxia
articles.snippet:
The history of Pelaxia dates to the Antiquity when the pre-Caphirian peoples of the Kindred coast of the Pelaxian Valley made contact with the Kosalis and the first writing systems known as Paleopelaxian scripts were developed. In 1485, Jerónimo De Pardo, the Grand Duke of Agrila, unified Pelaxia as a dynastic union of disparate predecessor kingdoms vassals to Caphiria; its modern form of a republic was established in 1852. 

After the completion of the Union of Alahuela and the creation of the Carto-Pelaxian Commonwealth, the Crown began to explore across the Kindred Sea, expanding into Vallos and marking the beginning of the Golden Age. Until the 1750s, Pardorian Pelaxia was the one of most powerful states in Sarpedon. During this period, Pelaxia was involved in all major Sarpedonian Wars, including the Kindred Wars. Carto-Pelaxian power declined in the latter part of the 18th century. 

In the early part of the 19th century, most of the former Pelaxian Empire overseas disintegrated.

==== Arrival in Northern Dolong Wetlands and the Reign of Habass ====
In the 4th century BCE Buddhist princes that were expelled by the {{Wp|Zoroastrian}} Emperor of the [[Arunid Empire]] Aadesh. These landless princess followed historical Arunid trade routes until they came upon the Ther people in the far north of [[Audonia]]. Upon discovering the indigenous and underdeveloped Ther people, the Arunid princes thought it was their religious duty to enlighten the Ther. They introduced written language to the Ther people and divided the land into realms that would be distributed among the princes. Historically, these entites existed more as monarchal city states that coexisted peacefully with one another. Arunidisation saw the introduction of Wet Rice Agriculture, The Sanskrit writing system, and advancements in administrative and legal thought. By and large, the Arunids brought modern civilization to the Dolong wetlands.

articles.title: Kapuhenasa
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}

The Kapuhenasa is the indigenous religion of the Loa people and is followed by almost the entirety of Takatta Loa, with around 70% practicing it exclusively and the remaining 30% practicing it in tandem with Islam. Originating from the writings of the Anahuenna of the 1500s and subsequent Books of Ecdysis and the teachings of Saȳd Kamáv Istiklav, a [[Kiravia|Kiravian]] Sufi mystic, it developed throughout the late 1700s and 1800s, and came to be called Kapuhenasa first in 1866. His followers were largely local mystics, philosophers and theologians and after his death they adapted his teachings to their local philosophy of “Ecdysis and Imago” as well as the practices of spirit possession. Eventually the Kapuhenasa came to be developed and thought of as its own distinct and organized religion. [[File:Sign DangerMines.jpg|thumb|A land mine warning sign in central Puertego]]
Land mines in Puertego remain a large thorn in the countries side especially in the country's rural areas. The primary reason for the massive presence of land mines is the country's history of constant civil wars in which mine fields were placed in order to prevent or slow the crossing of enemy armies which has taken a very severe toll on the countries people with Puertego having one of the highest numbers of amputees per capita in the world. The Puertegan Commission for Demining (PCD) claims that there around 11 million mines in the country with this number primarily focused on the center of the country however with other pieces of unexploded ordnance such as artillery shells, cluster bombs, and bunker blasters included this number is estimated to run as high as 14 million.

articles.title: Loa_Luni-Ecdysial_Calendar
articles.snippet:
The '''Loa Luni-Ecdysial calendar''', called the ''Marataka Hiraka'' in [[Insuo Loa]] or Silk Calendar, is the calendar in use in [[Takatta Loa]] with several overseas Loa communities using this calendar in an unofficial capacity. It is a dual system calendar, with one half of the calendar being a lunar calendar and the other being an ecdysial calendar, that is one centered around a 365 day year and the life cycles of the [[Loa Silk Moth]].

==History==
The Polynesians have since time immemorial revered the moon, viewing it as a source or power or ''mana''. The [[Loa]] would come to see it as the arbiter of divine and natural law. As such, lunar calendars are well attested since at least 600 CE, with archaeological sites unearthing several pictographic representations that resemble lunar calendars of later literate periods. articles.title: Pelaxian_Nobility
articles.snippet:
The '''Pelaxian nobility''' was a social class enshrined in the laws of the [[Kingdom of Pelaxia]] and the [[Carto-Pelaxian Commonwealth]] with specific privileges, prerogatives, obligations and regulations. The nobility ranked immediately after royalty and was itself subdivided into a number of subcategories which included the titled nobility and nobility of blood at the top and civic nobility at the bottom, encompassing a small, but not insignificant proportion of Pelaxia's citizenry.

Nobles had a specific legal status and held most of the wealth and various privileges denied to other classes, mainly politicians. In most of the former Pelaxian comarcas it was the only class that had access to high-level government positions. They also practically monopolized the most distinguished positions in the city-states and in the [[Catholic Church]] for a long time.
