'''Brother Auggie''' ([[Burgundian Language|Burg]]: ''Fra Augment or Fra Auggie''), meaning Brother Increase, is the satirical personification of [[Bergendii]] merchant elite. He was also used as an emblem of [[Burgundie]] in general and can be an allegory of {{wpl|capitalism}}. The catchphrase "Fra Auggie" came into use when a [[Kiravia]]ian general fighting the [[Ile Burgundie]] in the [[Kiro-Burgundian Wars]] of the 18th century, sought supplies and a number of [[Bergendii]] merchants came to his aid. His slight originally meant "one who increases his own wealth at the expense of his brothers", but the meaning was simplified in order to make it more accessible when picked up by the tabloids. [[File:Burg Metropole Country Map.png|right|thumb|Map of the Burgoignesc Metropole.]]
The Burgoignesc Metropole, sometimes called [[Levantia|Levantine]] [[Burgundie]], is a cultural designation for the three constituent countries of [[Ile Burgundie]], [[Nostrestran]], and [[Faramount]] of the nation of [[Burgundie]]. It is not a political entity and has no legal status. It spans an area of 1,659,897.5km.

==Etymology==
The Burgoignesc metropole is based on the [[Istroya]]n word "metropolis" meaning mother city. Metropolis has since come, in the international community, a large city, and in southern ([[Catholic Church|Catholic]]) [[Levantia]], the seat of a metropolitan or archbishop. Metropole itself has come to specifically mean "the parent state of a colony", popularized as a neolog to describe [[Burgundie]], separate from its far-flung holdings that make up the [[Burgoignesc Thalattocracy]].

The '''Kingdom of the Decapolis''' was a short-lived entity comprised of the former [[Great Levantia|Great Levantine]] provinces of [[Decapolitania Inferior]] and [[Decapolitania Superior]]. The Kingdom was established in [[512]] AD when the governor of Decapolitania Inferior - Marcus Cassius Macro - had himself crowned ''Rex'' and was subsequently recognized by its neighboring province. For a brief period, the Kingdom was among the largest of the [[Levantine Interregnum|post-Levantine]] states, encompassing most of modern day [[Burgundie]] and [[Gassavelia]]. Macro and the cities of the Decapolis almost immediately came into conflict, though the sources are sparse on detail about the specific nature of the tension. Tensions continued until Macro's son Gaius was assassinated in [[544]] and the realm disintegrated into city-states. The '''Dericanian High Plains''' are the interior plains above the coastal plains and river basins in the historical region of [[Levantia]] called [[Dericania]] rising 500 - 1500 meters (1640 - 4921 feet) above sea level. It crosses [[Burgundie]] in the southeast, [[Lapody]] in the southern central part of the plains, [[Rhotia]] in the northern central part of the plains, and parts of southern [[Fiannria]] and [[Hollona and Diorisia]] in the plain's extreme north. The High plains are subtropical dry summer climate with a band of semi-arid plains bisecting the zone.

For much of its early aviation history, 1850s-1940s, [[Burgundie]] was a leader in [[airship]] design and production. During the latter half of the [[Second Great War]] with the boom of airplane technology [[Burgundie]] fell behind. It’s attempts at early airplane and jet design were rudimentary and most often outsourced to more experienced nations. During [[Operation Kipling]] [[Burgundie]] saw a locally important development of a military jet aircraft industry. Following the [[Quds War]], [[Burgundie]] has continued to focus on building aircraft for its own domestic market but has increasingly involve its [[Levantine Union Defense Council]] allies in the R&D to ensure it is meeting modern standards.
==Early balloons==

{{Burgoignesc Security Forces}}
For much of its history Burgundie has relied on mercenaries from the various principalities of [[Maritime Dericania]] for land-based defense. Following its unification, in [[1875]], [[Burgundie]] entered a world where armored warfare was still solely a realm of the sea. However, that changed during the [[War of St. Brendan's Strait]] when [[Kiravia]] fielded a small number of mobile pill boxes. While the war formally ended the [[Kiro-Burgoignesc Wars]], and the nautical arms race between [[Kiravia]] and [[Burgundie]], it sparked a global armored warfare arms race that exploded less than twenty years later with the outbreak of the [[Second Great War]].

== Chariots ==
Upon the arrival of the first Latinic settlers a clear advantage was demonstrated in their use of chariots, over their Feinii, Albagubrians, and Levzeish foe. The chariot remained a staple in [[Bergendii]] armies until the 13th century, when under the rule of the Fanerian, the chariot fell o

articles.title: Development_of_military_logistics_in_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
{{Burgoignesc Security Forces}}
Throughout its history, the lands that make up modern [[Burgundie]] have maintained a strong lineage of military logistics which has always served it well. This was criticall important in the 17th-19th century when the [[Burgoignesc colonial empire]] was at its and it forged a lasting desire to not only be able to support military operations in close proximity to the [[Burgoignesc Metropole]] but also be able to sustain ongoing war fighting operations around the globe indefinitely. More so than any other nation, [[Burgundie]] has committed itself to the concept of global power projection through logistical capability first as opposed to combat capability. This dovetails with [[Burgundie]]'s global interests and to the untrained eye it would appear that the two are one and the same. That history, like the last sentence, is unending and brutal. The '''Eastern Hegemony''' was an early medieval league of cities in the northern and eastern [[Decapolis]] (including the island of [[Boregondia]]) who recognized the [[Kingdom of Pumbria|King of Pumbria]] as {{wp|hegemon}}. Unlike their southern and western neighbors in the [[Western Hegemony (Levantia)|Western Hegemony]], the cities of the east never established significantly closer trade and cultural relations with their patron, and the relationship appears to have remained a pragmatic arrangement of tribute for protection. The hegemony was established around the year [[550]] AD - shortly after the disintegration of the [[Decapolis (Kingdom)|Kingdom of the Decapolis]] - and persisted until the 690s AD. The western portion of the Eastern Hegemony was conquered by the nascent state of [[Uzdehzanistan]]. articles.title: Geography_of_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
The [[Burgundie]] is a nation spread across the world with its capital and majority landmass, known as the Burgoignesc Metropole, on the southeastern coast of [[Levantia]]. 

The Burgoignesc Metropole is situated in the northern and eastern hemispheres. At its northernmost point the Metropole spans from 30° 15' 25" (30.2571°) north latitude in [[Levantx]] to 6° 54' 0" (6.9000°) north latitude at its southern most point in [[Faramount]] on the border with [[Urcea]]. At its westernmost point the Metropole's province of [[Esquinia]] reaches 17° 5' 56.4" (17.099 °) east longitude to 29° 40' 40.8" (29.678°) east longitude where [[Levantx]] also represents its easternmost reach. The Metropole has a total area of 1,687,869.35 sqkm (651,690 sqmi). It measures 8770.92km (5,450 mi) from north to south and 9446.84km (5,870 mi) east to west but the majority of that is the confluence of the [[Levantine Ocean]] the [[Sea of Istroya]]. Avisos and colonial avisos (Burg: ''apostle'' and ''apostle coloniel'', from the {{wp|Ancient Greek|Istroyan}} word ''apostello'' meaning dispatch) are purpose-built ships in modern day [[Burgundie]], with the ship's type dating back to the 16th century and the early expansion of [[Maritime Dericania]]'s influence in [[Audonia]] and [[Vallos]]. They have been one of the most adapted vessel types in the [[Shipstory of Burgundie|Burgoignesc maritime history]], serving as dispatch vessels, communication relays, patrol craft, commando transports, and platforms for {{wp|USVs}}. Originally used as rapid and ultra-long-range dispatch carriers, their role is central to [[Burgundie]]'s development of long-range communications and its dominance in that sphere until the contemporary era.

articles.title: List_of_dynamite_gun_cruisers_of_the_Navy_of_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
{{wp|Dynamite gun crusiers}}, (Burg: Corsaires Combatantes, Canon Pneumatique (CCCP)) were a short lived, purpose built platform for the dynamite gun. They were touted to be the next great big thing in naval innovation but severely failed as a ship-to-ship combatant. Designed during the [[Red Interregnum]] they were much lighter and therefore faster then other cruisers, but that was because their main armament were three stationary pneumatic tubes that launched a dynamite packed shell to a maximum distance of a mile. After the first was completed it was determined that instead it could serve as a night raider on enemy coastal positions. In this role it was successful and is considered the first "stealth" ship in the [[Navy of Burgundie]].

Two more were ordered but where not completed before the end of the Red Interregnum. The advent of the Dreadnought rendered the dynamite cruisers obsolete a few years later. They did see service in the [[War of St. Brendan's Strait]] but were refitte

articles.title: List_of_icebreaker_classes_of_the_Navy_of_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
Icebreakers (Burg: arieglacies, from the Latin meaning ice ram) have been purpose built ships in Burgundie dating back to the 13th century. Their mission primarily falls under the Kilikas Sea and Omnium Ocean Commands of the Revenue Guard, but the Navy operates a number of vessels with icebreaking capabilities. The Revenue Guard maintains 12 icebreakers and the Navy has 4 ships with icebreaking capabilities.

==History==
The Royal Icebreaker Squadrons emerged in the late 19th century, not merely as a response to a unified [[Burgundie]]'s expanding maritime interests, but as a testament to the burgeoning technological advancements that allowed for navigation in the challenging waters of [[Kiro-Borealis]] and [[Australis]]. While the [[Navy 
of Burgundie]] recognized the strategic necessity of such a capability, the initial development of these specialized vessels was a

articles.snippet:
Since being designed by the [[Paulastra]]n navy in the 1860s the {{wpl|Monitor_(warship)|monitor}} and its later iterations of the {{wpl|Monitor_(warship)#River_monitors|river monitor}} and {{wpl|Monitor_(warship)#Submarine_gunboats|submarine gunboat}} have all served in the [[Navy of Burgundie]] under the designation [[Burgoignesc language|Burg]]: Obusiervaissel (howitzer ship) ''O''. These are purpose-built ships for coastal or riparian bombardment. While ships throughout [[Shipstory of Burgundie|Burgoignesc naval history]] have conducted these roles, it was never the sole intended purpose of these ships. And while [[List of dynamite gun cruisers of the Navy of Burgundie|dynamite gun cruisers]] served in the role of monitor they were not intended for that purpose, then were repurposed as torpedo cruisers soon after their adoption, and their armament was discarded as a fantastical pipe dream and as such are not included in this list.

articles.title: List_of_powerships_of_the_Navy_of_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
Powerships (Burg: ''Dinamovaissel'') have been purpose built ships in Burgundie dating back to the Great War, the first being in 1930. For the remainder of the 20th century powerships were existing hulks that were retrofitted for their power generating purposes. They served a number of communities and military efforts in 1930s-1960s until the advent of commercial nuclear power in Burgundie. They were crucial during Operation Kipling and in the late 1970s also became a vital resource to the Department of Total Defense after responding to coastal emergencies. The Navy of Burgundie currently maintains 9 powerships, 2 are permanently on loan to the Department of Total Defense, 3 are on loan to local utilities on missions, 2 are on in dry dock, and the remaining two are ready to be deployed whenever and wherever their country calls them. == History == As the Second Fratricide dragged on, the Army of Burgundie operating in Deric territory needed a reliable power.

'''Sacred Ash''' is a substance used within [[Caphiric Catholicism]]. It is created by the burning of consecrated hosts during the liturgy at the [[Caphiric_Rite#Oblation_of_Fire|Oblation of Fire]], and is used for a variety of purposes. Recognized as an ashen product of the {{wp|Real presence of Christ in the Eucharist|true presence in the Eucharist}}, it is held with high regard and veneration.

===Home lintels===
Within Caphiric Catholic tradition, sacred ash is used whenever an individual or family moves into a new home. As the home is entered, Sacred Ash is spread on the {{wp|lintel}} of the doorway. articles.title: Science_and_Technology_in_Burgundie
articles.snippet:
'''Science and technology in Burgundie''' are foundational pillars of the nation's economy, military, and cultural identity. In [[2040]], [[Burgundie]] is a recognized global leader in artificial intelligence, automation, biotechnology, and sustainable energy. This advanced state is the result of the nation's long-term strategic doctrines and a deeply ingrained cultural philosophy that prioritizes innovation as the primary means to achieve national prosperity and resilience.

The development of technology in Burgundie is guided by two core principles. [[Ephemeralization in Burgundie]] is the drive to achieve greater outcomes with fewer resources, and [[Total Economic Engagement]] (TEE) is the national strategy focused on empowering every citizen to contribute their maximum potential to the economy. This has resulted in a highly efficient, post-industrial society with a robust social safety net and a high standard of living.

articles.title: Western_Hegemony_(Levantia)
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Western Hegemony''' was an early medieval entity, comprised of the western cities of the [[Decapolis]] who were under the hegemony of the King of [[Gallawa]]. The hegemony was established in about [[565]] after a chaotic two decades since the collapse of the [[Decapolis (Kingdom)|Kingdom of the Decapolis]]. As the name would suggest, the hegemony was a loose association of the Decapolitan cities which relied on Gallawa for protection in exchange for tribute and certain trade rights. Over the next century, the cities in the Western Hegemony became close trade partners with the King of Gallawa, creating the basis for the medieval ''[[Via Dericanus]]''. Modern language scholars trace a greater, albeit minor, influence of vocabulary and language structure from Gallawa on the [[Littoric language]] descendant languages spoken in western [[Burgundie]]. The Western Hegemony was conquered by adventurers from [[Audonia]] in the 680s, forming the core region of [[Uzdehzanistan]].

articles.title: 2:1_Plan
articles.snippet:
The '''2:1 Plan''', also referred to as the Vandarch First Policy, was a maritime strategic policy and planning effort initiated by the [[Kingdom of the Fhainn]] in 1878. It was a counter to an opposing school of thought focused on an open seas navy, the Tri-Oceanic Plan, which rose in response to the question of how to best handle the issue of split naval development between the calmer inland sea of the [[Vandarch]] and the tradebearing and foreign-dominated high seas.

The 2:1 Plan called for at least two-thirds of the navy to be built in the Vandarch Sea in order to ensure Fhainnin naval dominance in the Vandarch, which was considered more critical than challenging a peer competitor on the open ocean due to Faneria's geopolitical and industrial core being situated directly along its coast. articles.title: Aeirbreach_A35M
articles.snippet:
[[File:A35M-1.jpg|thumb|A35M with service crew, 1937.]]
The General Airworks A35M (Type 1935 Heavy Aerofighter) was a heavy fighter/interceptor developed by Fanerian state manufacturer [[Ginearált Aeirbreach]] during the [[Second Great War]].

The A35M began development in 1933 as an offshoot of the A34T, a replacement project for the earlier A31T fighter-bomber. The project was redeveloped into two strains, separating the A35M's intended role as a dedicated interceptor from the A34T's ground attack specialization. GA's main competitors had at that point produced overall inferior engines for large aircraft, with the A35M being GA's first significant fighter project since the 1920s. The A35M and its upgrades formed the basis of Fanerian heavy fighters from their deployment in 1937 through to the end of the war.

articles.title: Big_Six_(Faneria)
articles.snippet:
The '''Big Six''' is a term used to describe the largest internationally-operating companies headquartered in or self-described as being of [[Faneria|Fhainnin]] origin. These companies ([[Feil Sinn Electronics]], [[Spréach Incorporated]], [[Baen Avionics]], [[Targaidt Prìse|Target Price]], [[Clonroche Medical]], and [[Potato House]]) are some of the most internationally recognizable or largest non-state owned companies operating out of Faneria, and form the 'face' of Fhainnin culture globally. While some are overshadowed by industrial giants in-country, each contributes to perceptions of Fhainnin culture as technically-skilled, diligent, and competitive. While an unofficial grouping, each company has received various degrees of support from the Fhainnin government in the form of export or tax exceptions due to their outsized impact on the national economy.

[[Category:Companies of Faneria]]

articles.title: Braid_of_Damocles
articles.snippet:
The '''Braid of Damocles''', sometimes called the '''King's Braid''', is a braided cord similar to an {{wp|aiguillette}} or [[Burgundie|Burgundine]] {{wp|Fourragère}} used in the [[Office of the National Army (Faneria)|National Army]] of [[Faneria]] and some Gaelic paramilitary groups. Though traditionally a simple two-cord braid worn attached to either the uniform or the uniform and dress sword, variations which combine the tradition with dress uniform aiguillettes exist in the form of a two-color option (compared to the otherwise monochrome aiguillettes used in the Fhainnin Army). The cord itself is a red or overlapped red and gold cord tightly bound with an angle of overlap of 45 degrees.

==Origins==

The term behind the Braid, the 'Bond of Damocles', was first coined by Latin scholar Visivius Atticus, who observed the election of an officer from the ranks of a gaelic ''ceitern'' in modern [[Itheachan]], [[Faneria]]. Though previously recorded locally and by Coscivian writers simpl

articles.title: Brier_International
articles.snippet:
'''Brier International''' is a banking, brokerage, and financial management institution which operates out of headquarters in [[Leighlinbridge]], [[Faneria]]. It is the largest bank based in northern [[Levantia]] and the sixth largest bank in the world by number of customers as of its acquisition of Metekis Banking and Loans in 2026.

Brier International, formerly Brier Financial, has acquired a number of financial firms and smaller banks, going so far as to be accused of primarily expanding into new markets through targeted headhunting and legal predation. This is only partly true, as the company is careful to stay within local law. In practice, Brier International purchases and rennovates failing financial firms and banks, seeing periodic surges during economic slumps.

articles.snippet:
'''Clonroche Medical''' is a publicly-owned pharmecutical company specializing in antivirals and antiparasitical medications based out of Clonroche, [[Faneria]]. It was founded in 1892 and operates manufacturing facilities in Faneria, [[Fiannria]], [[Eldmora-Regulus]], [[Kiravia]], and [[Burgundie]].

==History==


==Notable Products==
====Trofannol====
''Trofannol'', coming from Fhasen for 'tropical', is a pill taken as a countermeasure for {{wp|Malaria}}. It is taken either once daily with 80mg or twice daily with 40mg for patients who have already contracted malaria; in roughly 80% of cases, a full cycle of Trofannol purges the parasite from the human body. It was first used in 1987 as a replacement for {{wp|Chloroquinine}}, which faced growing resistance from malaria strains; however, Trofannol successfully attacks {{wp|Plasmodium falciparum}}, the primary resistant variant. articles.title: Dealbhtaigh_architecture
articles.snippet:
'''Dealbhtaigh''', or 'living design', refers to both the Dealbhtaigh architectural firm and the architectural style of the same name. In recent years, it has expanded to include modernist art in the same style as the graphics and interior design aesthetic produced by these, referred to as '''Dealbhtaigh Style'''. Founded in [[Leighlinbridge]] in 1948 by two partners, Kerry MacLinney and Richard Reaen, the firm became a sensation and a predominant influence in Fhainnin building design in the latter half of the 20th Centyury, inspiring numerous copycat architects and informing much of the basis of the currently dominant [[Fhainnin New Millennium Architecture|New Millennium style]].

articles.title: Feil_Sinn_Electronics
articles.snippet:
'''Feil Sinn Electronics''' is a multinational consumer electronics and electronics component producer headquartered in [[Leighlinbridge]], [[Faneria]]. Feil Sinn is best known for its line of home computers, the 'Feil-Safe' line of adblock and VPN softwares, the internet browser ''Eolach'' ([[Enlighten (web browser)|Enlighten]]), and its Office User Programs suite. Additionally, Feil Sinn's largest subsidiary, FS Engineering, produces electronic components for various appliances and other products from microwaves to planes. Feil Sinn ranked 2nd largest personal computer company by gross revenue globally after [[Nexus S.A.]] in 2030 and is the largest supplier of home computers in the Coscivian and Gaelic world, as well as third largest globally for semiconductor production, seventh for smartphones, and twelfth largest for appliance electronics parts. It is considered one of the [[Big Six (Faneria)|Big Six]] Fanerian companies.

articles.title: IBA_Computing
articles.snippet:
'''IBA Computing''' is a computer manufacturing and software company operating out of [[Faneria]]. It is a publicly-owned internationally operating corporation specializing in {{wp|centralized computing}} for businesses and public institutions, as well as business management, databasing, cloud storage, and bulk PC purchase services. IBA maintains numerous contracts with both companies and the Fhainnin government, and produces computers compatible with both the FeallsanOS and SFOS systems produces by [[Ginearált Dealbhadh Coimpiutair|General Computing]] and [[Feil Sinn Electronics]] respectively, with the former being used solely by the Fhainnin government and the latter as a popular business and consumer OS.

articles.title: Spréach_Incorporated
articles.snippet:
'''Spréach Incorporated''', or simply '''Spréach''', is a publicly-owned soft drink company with headquarters in [[Leighlinbridge]], [[Faneria]], best known for its titular drink, Spréach. It is an internationally operating company and a major contender to the more widely-known [[Paulastra|Paulastran]] brand [[Imperial Cola]]. The company was founded in 1910 by entrepreneur Thomas MacCirrin, who created the formula for Spréach Original.
==History==
Beginning as a small soft drink mill in its headquarter city, Spréach Inc. became a popular producer of soft drinks during the [[Second Great War]], as it was able to procure the ingredients it needed through neutral shipping while other industries such as ice cream ran on tight shortages, making it a popular treat for the wartime generation. articles.title: Talerzone
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
The '''Talerzone''', officially called the '''Taler Area''', is a monetary union of the fifteen [[Levantine Union]] (LU) member states which have adopted the [[Taler]] (₮) as their common currency and sole legal tender. The monetary authority of the Talerzone is the Levantine Union Market and Currency Authority. The Talerzone additionally extends to non-Levantine Union members, including those members of the [[Nysdra Sea Treaty Association]].

[[File:Talerzone.png|960px|thumb|right|A map of countries that use the Taler as legal tender. The darker blue in Levantia is contiguous with the [[Levantine Union]]. For clarity, Urcean colonies in [[Crona]] are colored the same as the metropole, though they are associated with the Nysdra Currency Area. Other nations in dull blue allow the use of the Taler in conjunction with local currency or have their currency's value tied to that of the Taler.]]

articles.snippet:

'''Tommy's Crab Slab''' is an Aenglish-style pub and restaurant chain in [[Faneria]], [[Hollona and Diorisia]], [[Yonderre]], and parts of [[Hendalarsk]]. Its locations operate as a sit-down establishments where guests can watch part of their meals be cooked, and generally features a full bar and televisions with sports, news, and entertainment coverage. Since 2013, guests have been allowed to pick out, pet, and watch crabs, lobsters, and other creatures before they are prepared and cooked in full view either in a pot or on a large iron griddle. The chain specializes in seafood and has a detailed menu aimed primarily at pairing alcohols with various dishes.

articles.snippet:
The '''Tíotán''', or '''Titan landship''' or '''Falway's Failure''', was an experimental armored vehicle used in the later half of the [[Fhainnin Civil War]]. It was designed as a siege engine to circumvent tracks blown out to limit the Republican's use of armored trains. Overall, four were constructed. The design was noted as one of the earliest tanks to see combat service in spite of its poor performance.

Cheaston_UAV
articles.snippet:
[[File:Sukhoi Okhotnik-B.jpg|thumb|Cheaston taxiing, 2022.]]
The '''Cheaston BA-UA8''' ([[Istroyan]]: ''Xyston'') is an {{wp|Unmanned Aerial Vehicle}} produced by [[Baen Avionics]] for the [[Office of the National Army (Faneria)|Fhainnin Army]] and other buyers. It is a development of the BA-UA5 [[Logg UAV]] and was first commissioned in 2014, and operates as a high-altitude, medium-range, land-based ASM and ASHM cruise missile platform. The Cheaston is built to rapidly enter a battlespace to enhance naval strike capacity alongside manned air and naval missile packages, as well as provide an unmanned system for high-risk ground strike operations such as dedicated SEAD/DEAD missions against high-competency air defense targets. The Fanerian Army operates several dozen of the system, with production of parts and new systems planned until 2045. An extension of production was also begun in 2040 along with an upgrade package planned for existing systems.

articles.title: Fanerian_Revolution
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
The Fhainnin Civil War was a multi-party civil conflict which took place within the [[Kingdom of the Fhainn|Kingdom of Fhainnlannachaeran]] from 1906-1909 mainly between the Republicans, lead by [[Callac Cananach|Callac Cananach's]] [[Cananachan Republicanism|faction]], and the monarchy of Fhainnlannachaeran, largely under the umbrella of the [[Volunteer Armies for the Restoration of the Throne]] and the Royal Army of the Fhainn. It was sparked by a series of poor rulers, a disastrous defeat in the 1987-88 [[Fourth Kin War]], which was expected to be an easy victory, subsequent crackdowns on speech and association, and the refusal of the monarchy to extend the voting franchise for Vicars - local governors - to all landed men rather than only nobility.

articles.title: First_Princes'_War
articles.snippet:
The '''First Princes' War''', also referred to as the '''First Vicarial War''', was a series of interlocked civil conflicts in the [[Kingdom of the Fhainn]] that lasted from June 1519 to January 1545. It began over a dispute over the rights of vassal lords within the Kingdom and later expanded to a war over succession to the ''Chathairrih Fhainn'' by [[Clyde I of Faneria|Clyde Barheln]] through his marriage to the ''Rih''<nowiki/>'s sister, [[Bronsyn I of Faneria|Bronwyn]]. It consisted of three distinct phases - the Eastern Campaign, the Protestant Wars, and the Succession War. Depending on the source, it is also described as being either a direct cause of or the parent conflict of the [[Kurikilan Crusade]].

articles.title: Index_Celticus
articles.snippet:
{{Short description|Imperial registry and administrative system for Celtic peoples}} {{Italic title}} '''Index Celticus''' ({{lang-la|Index Celticus}}, "Celtic Register") was a semi-legendary administrative and ethnographic registry attributed to the imperial authorities of [[Great Levantia]], designed to catalogue, monitor, and regulate [[Celtic people|Celtic]] tribes and populations within imperial borders and peripheral regions. Though frequently referenced in later historiography, no complete version of the Index has survived, and its historical form remains a subject of scholarly debate. 
== Overview == 
The ''Index Celticus'' is described in fragmentary sources as a comprehensive registry containing demographic, ethnographic, and political information on Celtic tribes under imperial influence. It purportedly recorded tribal identities, leadership structures, territorial boundaries, tribute obligations, and degrees of integration into imperial governance. The registry is believed

articles.title: Jack_Conmoore
articles.snippet:
[[File:Kvarengi.jpg|thumb|Conmoore, painted in 1897.]]
Duke '''Jack Bellick Conmoore''' was a minor noble and notable industrialist in [[Faneria]] in the late 19th century. He was primarily involved in stocks, railroads, and mining charters, and was a highly controversial figure for his embracing the concept of {{wp|Company town|company towns}}, as well as his aggressive and later illegal stock market manipulation and presumably eating his competitors considering how stupidly fat he was. In addition, he was caught paying mercenaries to harass and attack his business rivals prior to a royal sanction in 1882. His actions and general demeanor lead to his becoming a symbol of corrupt business elite, and Conmoore was lampooned in early Republican and Socialist writings as a prime example of the issues of the monarchy in the late 1800s.

articles.title: Kettleship
articles.snippet:
A '''Kettleship''' (Fhs: '''Soitheaciteal''') was a type of warship built in the mid-16th to late 18th Centuries around the [[Vandarch|Vandarch Sea]]. Kettleships were the largest ships in the inland sea during most of the 16th and 17th Centuries, and were constructed around a wide, oval-shaped hull and posessed a forecastle angled bowwards, giving the design its name. The ship would consist of two or three decks, either propelled entirely by oars and towing or later by a mixture of oars and {{wp|Gaff rig|gaff sails}}. The top deck would be roofed with openings for sailors to access sails and rigging, which was fastened to the roof; the deck would typically be partially walled to obscure personnel and equipment onboard, with gunports and doors built into it. The construction of the ships was in most cases fairly simple, managing to leveraging the immature warship industry around the Vandarch coasts as well as the usually calm weather.

The following is a list of the holders of the ''Chathairrih Fhainnin'', the royal throne of the Fhainn, from the foundation of the Kingdom of [[Kingdom of the Fhainn|Fhainnlannachaerean]] to its dissolution in 1913. Each is titled ''Rih''(King) or ''Banrih''(Queen), with ''Dòchas'' referring to both local Princes, who were the chief vassals of the king, and the actual heirs of the ''Rih'', though the heirs also could expect their own principality independent of election to the Throne.

articles.title: Marcus_Faena
articles.snippet:
[[File:Sir Humphry Davy, Bt by Thomas Phillips.jpg|thumb|Portrait of Marcus Faena, painted 1832.]]
'''Marcus Faena''' was a Fhainnin inventor and chemist born in the city of Haldane in 1798, most famously known for founding the [[Faena Chemical-Electric|Faena Chemical Production Company]] in 1831 and his work in antiseptics and the chemical sciences. He was one of the largest contributors to the field of {{Wp|Inorganic chemistry|inorganic chemistry}} of the 19th and 20th Centuries and made several advances in medicinal and electrochemistry. 
==Early Life==
Marcus Faena was born to Marwyn and Ciria Faena in Haldane, Faneria in May 1798. Marcus' family were lower-middle-class, and Marwyn worked as an apothecary at his family shop, where Marcus helped as a child. Marcus attended private schooling locally, as his father placed an enormous importance on education; Marcus distinguished himself by passing many of his peers in literacy and mathematics at an early age. articles.title: Mitei
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''''Mitei''''' were a class of individuals in [[Cusinaut]] in the 17th and 18th century who were chosen to serve as representatives of constituent nations of the [[Northern Confederation]]. The term Mitei is an Algosh term referring to medicine man, though the term by the 1600s took on a general sense of a wise man, including medicine men, miscellaneous elders, indigenous philosophers, and other related types of persons. In the earliest version of the Northern Confederation's governance, Mitei were chosen to represent the constituent nations in the [[Northern_Confederation#Government|National Conference]] which oversaw the Confederation. The Mitei, as respected men, functioned as a kind of proto-{{wp|lobbyist}}, representing their "clients" on the basis of agreement rather than democratic representation or by appointed delegation. articles.title: Màrtainn_Royal_Graveyard
articles.snippet:
The Màrtainn Royal Graveyard, or informally (and incorrectly) the [[Kings of the Fhainn|Suthar-Màrtainn]] Royal Graveyard, is a park and memorial space covering twelve and a half acres roughly thirty miles south of the city limit of [[Oirthidún]]. It is the grave site for most of the immediate royal family of the Kingdom of Fhainnlannachaeran and select retainers and extended family, containing a total of 2,342 full or partial sets of remains in numerous individual graves and crypts. The graves on-site are roughly arranged by time of death, extending southwards away from the former site of the Vermillion Palace, the family retreat of the royalty.

==Founding==
The Graveyard was originally a park space for the Vermillion Palace, with the first grave being that of ______ Suthar-Màrtainn, who explicitly requested to be buried there with his wife as he particularly enjoyed the quiet retreat and curated gardens. articles.title: Project_ELIAH
articles.snippet:
'''Project ELIAH''' (''Eangan Líonrach na Idirghabhála Aeir forluiteacH'', or '''Networked Overlapping Air Intercept Grid''')  is an integrated multi-layer air defense system employed by the [[Office of the National Army (Faneria)|military]] of [[Faneria]] since the early 2000s. It was originally envisioned as a copy of the [[Caphiria|Caphirian]] [[Trinity Defense System|Trinity system]] following repeated simulations and fire exercises resulting in predictions of severe oversaturation of air-based targets by varying naval and land-based missile defenses, but has since expanded to general air defense coordination, networked fire control, and automated communications. The acronym is meant as an homage to Saint Eliah, the patron saint of rain, thunder, and lightning.

The '''ROBOBAMOR BA-UA9''' (Aen. ''MEGADEATHBOT'') is a heavy military proof-of-concept {{wp|Unmanned combat aerial vehicle|UAV}} system produced by [[Baen Avionics]] solely for the [[Office of the National Army (Faneria)|National Army of Faneria]] since 2027. ROBOBAMOR was developed from the [[Cheaston UAV|Cheaston Drone]] as an extreme-range stealth bomber, allowing for the deployment of heavy ASM and ASHM cruise missiles on a continental range from a home base without the need for considerations of crew fatigue. In addition, the UAV features advanced electronic countermeasures and stealth features. The project, originally considered a high-cost, niche asset, was expanded significantly in 2040, with an order for eighty additional systems being placed as part of a program to supplement manned platforms with more expendable unmanned ones. articles.title: Ruaridh_Màrtainn
articles.snippet:
'''Ruaridh Màrtainn''' was a ''Dòchas'' of Cheatharnaich, a principality to the west and north of the [[Gheal River|Abhain Gheal]] with its capital based in [[Cancale]]. He ruled Cheatharnaich from 1355-1394 and gained the title of ''Dòchas'' of Mhartainnvail, the Màrtainn ancestral seat, as well as personal ownership of the city of [[Connsmonandún]] in 1382. Ruaridh was the father of [[Rethys I of Faneria|Rethys the First]], the first King of the Fhainn.

articles.title: Saint_Hendrick
articles.snippet:
'''Saint Hendrick''', born Henry Browen, was abbot of a monastic order in the modern [[Kestrel Isles]] and a skilled orator who lived in the eighth and ninth centuries A.D. after the collapse of the Gothic-controlled territories under [[Eleglass of Cranwyrth]]. His connections both with travelling Christian preachers and his position as second son of a Holy Levantine noble family allowed him to attain the permission of the Principality of Itheachan, the primary power in the northeastern Vandarch of the era, to construct permanent Christian churches and repeal anti-Christian decrees, which significantly impacted the speed of Christianization in Northern Levantia. As a Saint, Browen is considered a patron saint of lone travelers and diplomats in the Catholic Church, as well as a patron of the laity more broadly in the Northern Rite.

articles.snippet:
{{WIP}}
[[File:Redoutable.png|thumb]]
The '''Sochrach-class submarine''' (Aen. ''Gainful''<ref>Sochrach broadly means 'Gainful/Productive/Beneficial/Helpful' in respect to labor.</ref>) is a type of nuclear-powered ballistic and cruise missile submarine built for the [[Office of the National Army (Faneria)|Army Naval Service]] of [[Faneria]]. The largest and newest class of strategic submarines currently in service with the Fhainnin navy, the Gainfuls form the front line of Faneria's [[Nuclear Programs and Policy of Faneria|nuclear retaliation capability]]. Since their introduction, the older [[Gaisgeil-class submarine|Gallant class]] are believed to largely have been reduced to a primarily cruise missile role due to the advances in stealth capabilities and warhead capacity brought by the new vessels.

[[File:SēoraLocator.png|thumb|Location of Sēora within Great Kirav]]

'''Sēora''' is a [[Metaregion|region]] of the [[Kiravian Federacy]] located in nothern [[Great Kirav]] amid the [[Fresh Seas]].

==History==

==Geography==
The defining geographic feature of Sēora are the Fresh Seas, a belt of large lakes that surround each of the provinces of Sēora on at least two sides. The Fresh Seas collectively form one of the largest (if not the largest) reserves of liquid freshwater in the world.

==Provinces==
Sēora comprises six states, one territory, and one federal district.

==Society and Culture==
Sēora is home to many small ethnic groups, both Coscivian and ''[[Urom]]'', mostly speaking languages of Elutic stock or belonging to the Sēoran branch of the Cosco-Adratic family. There are also significant populations of North Coscivians and Kir people.

===Urbanisation===
The largest city in Sēora is [[Cities of Kiravia#Ilminsar|Ilminsar]].

Most of West Kirea is part of the Great Kiravian Basin, a landscape depressed and abraded by glaciers during the last ice age, leaving a vast plain with many lakes both large and small. West Kirea spans the western and southwestern rim of the Great Basin, straddling its interface with the ranges of the [[Great_Kirav#Topography|Western Highlands]]. A geologically related but culturally distinct upland region, the Katavalka, forms an arc through the central portions of Province №52 and Devahoma.

'''Ankae''' is [[Metzetta|Metzetta's]] second-largest city, with a population of 3.5 million and an area of 430 square miles. It is one of Metzetta's Metropolitan Cities, which are not part of any province. Historically it was the capital of [[Daekang]]. Found on Metzetta's southeast coast, it is the country's most important port.
== Etymology ==
"An" denotes "a place where land and sea meet," while "kae" means "wild." Altogether Ankae is thought to refer to the place where the wild currents of the sea meet the land.
== History ==
Ankae was the capital of Daekang, the ancient kingdom which fell to Meseda-jo in 85 BC.
== Geography ==
Ankae is found on Metzetta's southeast coast.
=== Administrative Divisions ===
Ankae is divided into 16 gu (districts) which are in turn divided into dong (neighbourhoods).

articles.title: Aurema
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}
The '''Aurema''' is a large {{wp|savanna}} which runs north to south in the interior of [[Urcea]]'s [[The Gold Coast (Urcea)|Gold Coast]], its western coastal region. This corridor, which runs about 1,100 miles northwest to southeast, was historically one of southwest Levantia's most important agricultural regions, gaining special significance due to the lack of viable farming to its west in the [[Glása rainforest]] or to the east on the [[Urcean frontier]].
==Etymology==
"Aurema" originated as a [[Lebhan language|Lebhan]] development of the Latin name ''aureum mare'', the "golden sea", a term with documented use dating back to the [[Latin Heroic Age]]. Based on the earliest Heroic Age legends, the name referred to the agricultural output as well as its literal physical appearance, which differed dramatically from both the climate of [[Urlazio]] as well as the [[Glása rainforest]] which historically ran up and down Urcea's entire coast.

articles.title: Belioné
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Belioné''' is a pass through the [[Ionian Mountains]] that connects the province of [[North Ionia]] with the state of [[Ænglasmarch]] in northeastern [[Urcea]]. It sits at the northeastern "corner" of the Ionians and is formed by the flow of the Corlin, a triburary of the [[Esquiline River]]. It is significant as the widest pass in the Ionians east of [[Conflúent]], and the easiest to travail both because of the relatively smooth terrain but also the ready availability of freshwater (from the Corlin). The Corlin's north-south direction also makes the Belioné easy to navigate without losing direction. As such, it was long the preferred route of traders, civilians, and armies alike during antiquity through the early modern period, and was a major strategic priority for both offensive and defensive campaigns into Urcea. The Belioné was the critical feature of the ''[[Via Ionia]]'', a [[Great Levantia|Great Levantine]] road that connected Ionia to the [[Norteven River]].

'''Christianity in [[Metzetta]]''' is among the nation's minority religions, with most of the population following the national faith of [[Chulcheo]]. Less than 2% of the population affirm Christian belief, however most large Christian denominations maintain a presence in the country. While a minority faith, Christianity has been influential on [[Culture of Metzetta|Metzetta's culture]], particularly Christian wedding ceremonies. The religion has had a presence in Metzetta since 1604 when 10 Christian intellectuals arrived from [[Aciria]] with [[Fulvio Pisani]] under the orders of [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]] Ingun.

articles.title: Clans_of_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Metzetta]] has a small pool of only 311 extant family names, an unusually low number for a country of its size. One's family name or clan is seen as a central part of one's identity. New family names are very seldom created and there is no existing legal structure for changing names in Metzetta. Clans fit into several categories defined by their origin (often a fictitious origin perpetuated by the clans themselves) and regularly publish books detailing their numbers in various regions and extensive family trees. Each family has an associated shrine which members of the clan financially contribute to if they wish. Marrying within one's clan is considered a strong taboo tantamount to incest even if there is no known blood relation present.

== Imperial Clan and cadet branches ==
The foremost clan in [[Metzetta]] is the [[Metzettan Imperial Family|Imperial Clan]]; it is the only clan which changes its name, which happens every time Metzetta is ruled by an [[Emperor of Metzetta|Empress]]

articles.snippet:
[[File:Imperial Cola Nasastan ad.png|250px|thumb|Nasastani Imperial Cola ad from 1991]]

The '''Cola Accords''' ([[Pomorskitong]]: ''Kolaakordy'') were a series of agreements signed in early 1982 between the [[Government of Nasastan]] and [[Imperial Cola]], a major beverage corporation based in [[Paulastra]]. The accords established a comprehensive framework for Imperial Cola's exclusive management of the cola beverage market in [[Nasastan]], marking the beginning of economic relations between the two states.

Nasastan's government, which encouraged the production and consumption of native beverages and maintained a cautious stance toward foreign influence, sought to regulate foreign corporate activity in the country. Rather than allowing uncontrolled market competition, the United Ministry of Central Economic Regulation of Nasastan proposed a structured agreement with Imperial Cola to oversee and centralize cola-related business operations under a single, trusted foreign partner.

articles.snippet:
[[File:KiravianDwarf.png|thumb|Lord Kadarius Vurśauv, a 16th century AD [[Xūrosar]] financier fond of purchasing titles of nobility]]
'''Dwarfism in Kiravia''' is documented from [[Ancient history of Kiravia|ancient times]]. In Kiravia's hierarchical and deeply segmented society, persons with {{wp|dwarfism}} in Kiravia have in most cases been treated differently than people with normal stature of the same background, sometimes for the sake of their own welfare, but also as a form of discrimination and exploitation. People with dwarfism have made notable contributions to Kiravian society and Coscivian civilisation, and have come to enjoy greater equality and opportunity in the modern era, but many continue to suffer from various social ills on account of their stature.

'''Geo-ban''' (거 반) is a [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] aesthetic ideal and [[Metzettan philosophy|philosophic]] concept relating to unity, repetition, imperfection, cohesion and subtle variation. It is present throughout all forms of Metzettan art, [[Culture of Metzetta|culture]] and [[Metzettan people|society]] and is formed by the interplay between the two complementary concepts of ''geo'' and ''ban.''

Geo-ban is most commonly understood in the west through its visual component which is found in patterns which appear to be formed from identical components which, when examined more closely, are found not to be identical at all, leading seemingly straight lines to form great contours, and apparently well-ordered sets to devolve into randomness. [[File:Gurémakengranat.png|thumb|250px|The Gurémakengranat with its [[w:Calyx (anatomy)|calyx]] structure intact]]
The '''gurémakengranat''', commonly known as the '''guréstone pomegranate''' in [[Ænglish language|Ænglish]], is a highly specialized and relict subspecies of the common [[w:Pomegranate|pomegranate]] ([[w:Binomial nomenclature|Scientific]]: ''Punica granatum'') that has undergone a remarkable evolutionary divergence over more than two centuries of isolation in remote, rocky alpine valleys of the [[Calywite Mountains]]. Known for its bizarre morphology, unique reproductive strategy, and strikingly intense flavor, the guréstone pomegranate is considered one of the most unusual fruit-bearing plants in [[Nasastan]] and a notable example of adaptive specialization within the Punica genus.

The subspecies belongs to the kingdom [[w:Plant|Plantae]], clade [[w:Flowering plant|Angiosperms]], clade [[w:Eudicots|Eudicots]], order [[w:Myrtales|Myrtales]], family [[w:Lythraceae|Lythrac

articles.snippet:
[[File:Attacus atlas (15050883139).jpg|thumb|Moths are considered harbingers of gwangye in Metzettan culture.]]
'''Gwangye''' (광 예) is a concept in [[Metzettan philosophy]] relating to coincidence, synchronicity and individual interpretation of improbable events. With [[Geo-Ban|geo-ban]], [[salajida]] and [[Juinui Son|juinui son]] it forms [[Kanjin|Kanjin's]] four heavenly virtues. The word "gwangye" can be roughly translated as "connection," referring to the central idea it posits which is that apparent coincidences create meaning within the observer. It is considered the most esoteric and difficult to grasp of the four virtues (possibly due to lacking a strong visual or tactile cue like the other virtues), and refers specifically to the appreciation and interpretation of unlikely events rather than the events themselves. articles.title: History_of_Canaery
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}
The '''history of [[Canaery]]''' traditionally dates from the arrival of the [[Adonerii]] to the area in the 800s BC and encompasses not only the history of the Electorate but also includes the gradual development of [[Cana]], the growth of the [[Caenish people]], and their settlement across a larger region now known as [[Greater Canaery]]. The development of the Caenish people and culture occurred within the context of Great Levantia's decline, the eventual rise of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]], and the gradual integration of Canaery into Urcea.

==Early history==
The area of Greater Canaery was very lightly populated in prehistoric times up through much of Antiquity, as the [[Gaelic people|indigineous Gaels]] of the north mostly avoided the region both due to the difficulty of traversing between it and [[The Gold Coast (Urcea)|the Gold Coast]] through the [[Hortus Mountains]] as well as due to its equatorial climate and dangerous fauna. Instead, the Celts of further nor

articles.title: Holidays_in_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
'''Festivals and holidays in [[Metzetta]]''' are long-running traditional celebrations held at specific times of year; formerly according to the lunar calendar, but using the solar calendar in modern times. There are several categories ranking how important these holidays are to the Metzettans; national holidays are widely celebrated and mean most businesses will close to give citizens a day off; national observances are only given as days off at the discretion of employers but are actively celebrated by the [[Government of Metzetta|government]]; and recognised celebrations are acknowledged as existing by the government but not actively celebrated or funded.

== National Holidays ==
National holidays are days off work for the vast majority of the population and are celebrated all across the country. Should a national holiday fall on a weekend, the day off will be moved to the next available working day. The most important celebrations are [[Saehae]], [[Gaehwa]] and [[

articles.title: Imperial_Regalia_of_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
The '''Imperial Regalia of Metzetta''' consists of the sword Daegeom, the flute Nunbusin Tanso and the crown Geolughan Gwan. According to legend, these treasures were gifted to [[Yang-jo]], [[Metzetta|Metzetta's]] first [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]] and mythical ancestor of the Metzettan imperial line. Traditionally they were a divine symbol of the Emperor's ancestry and authority, legitimising his rule.
== Daegeom ==
The sword '''Daegeom''' was, according to legend, a gift to [[Yang-jo|Yang]] from Ssaum, his grandfather and the god of war. The sword is kept in the High Priest's shrine in [[Hanzeong]] for safety when not being used. The sword represents the Emperor's strength.
== Nunbusin Tanso ==
The flute '''Nunbusin Tanso''' was, according to legend, a gift to [[Yang-jo|Yang]] from Hwajae, his grandmother and the goddess of love. The flute is kept in a dedicated shrine at the base of [[Mount Riwa]] where high-ranking priests watch over it. The flute represents th

articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:Incheon Cityscape.jpg|alt=Inyang cityscape|thumb|Inyang cityscape]]
'''Inyang''' is the fourth-largest city in [[Metzetta]], with a population of 2.7 million and an area of 380 square miles. It is one of Metzetta's Metropolitan Cities, meaning it is self-governing rather than being part of a province. Inyang is part of the [[Hanzeong]] metropolis, having been merged into by the sprawling capital, however it is still administered separately and has a distinct identity, even if the boundaries between the two cities have become increasingly blurred over time.
== Etymology ==
"In" means "perfect virtue" in [[Metzi]], while [[Yang-jo|Yang]] refers to [[Metzetta|Metzetta's]] first [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]]. Yang-jo is considered a borderline [[Chulcheo|religious figure]] in Metzetta and so naming a major city with reference to his perfection is not out of character for the Metzettans.

articles.title: Ionian_Hotel_War
articles.snippet:
The '''Ionian Hotel War''' was a rivalry of two prominent hotels in the [[Ionian Plateau]] of [[Urcea]] during the 19th century. Taking place during the [[Aedanicad]], the two hotels - the Velucian Palace and Hotel Julius - serve as both a historical episode and a symbol for the prosperity enjoyed in Urcea during the period. Both hotels were located within three miles of each other in the province of [[South Ionia]], occupying the same [[Ionian Mountains|mountain ridge]].

The Velucian Palace's direct predecessor - the Mountain View Inn - was a small boarding house constructed by Thomas Romo in 1767, sitting prominently among the [[Ionian Mountains]] and offering unrivaled views as well as . '''Iseul Oh''' (born 30 March 1946) was an ethnic [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] who later lived in [[Urcea]] following a landmark court case.
== Early life ==
Oh reports his early life was not a happy one, with his parents arguing often when he was young and eventually separating. He was rarely afforded his favourite treat of [[Daxian Aspic|Daxian aspic]] (charcoal flavour) and disliked his schoolteachers. Spending his school years skipping classes led to failed exams and limited career prospects, leading him to seek alternative citizenship.

{{Main|Iseul v. Ministry of State}}

articles.title: Jamsu
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:Daegu South Korea September 2001.jpg|alt=A view of Jamsu|thumb|A view of Jamsu]]
'''Jamsu''' is [[Metzetta|Metzetta's]] third-largest city, with a population of 2.8 million and an area of over 400 square miles. It is one of Metzetta's Metropolitan Cities, which are not part of any [[Provinces of Metzetta|province]]. It is the industrial heart of Metzetta, historically the centre of the country's textile trade but more recently heavy industry has overtaken the city, particularly [[Automotive Industry in Metzetta|automobile]] and electronics manufacturing. The humid climate of the area was also traditionally perfect for growing fruits, especially apples.
== Etymology ==
"Jam" translates as "age" or "epoch." "Su" translates roughly as "embroidery" which references the city's strong ties to the textile industry. Jamsu as a whole can be interpreted as encapsulating the glorious age of the textile industry which fuelled the area's growth.

articles.title: Janggwari
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
'''Janggwari''' is a village in [[Metzetta]] notable for having almost no electricity. The town has a school, a general store, a post office and a bar; there are 190 residents living in around 60 houses. Most residents still wear [[mettubok]] on a day-to-day basis. It is also famous as a producer of berries, the town's main export and the industry which employs most of the population; the village's name literally means "Village of Berries" or "Berry Village."

History.
=== Lack of electricity ===
Janggwari has forgone almost all electricity to preserve their sense of tradition, however a handful of exceptions have been tolerated in the village's small town hall; a defibrillator, a single telephone in the mayor's office and the only air-conditioner for miles around. '''Juinui Son''' (즨의 손) is a [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] aesthetic ideal and philosophic concept relating to the ultimate refinement of basic forms. Present throughout [[Culture of Metzetta|Metzettan culture]], in is one of the four heavenly virtues of [[Kanjin|Kanjinism]] along with [[Geo-Ban|geo-ban]], [[salajida]] and [[gwangye]]. "Juinui son" is usually translated as "master's hands," revealing the central idea of the worldview wherein simplicity belies quality. Juinui son provided a visual language recognised by Metzetta's ancient merchant class; unable to flaunt their wealth openly for fear of reprisal and theft they would find ways of being quietly understood as successful by other merchants. articles.snippet: '''Koskenkorvanism''', also known as '''Koskenkorvanianism''', '''pan-Koskenkorvanism''', or '''pan-Koskenkorvanianism''', is a {{wp|pan-nationalism|pan-nationalist}} political movement built around multiple {{wp|pseudoscience|pseudoscientific}} claims of both supposed biological and linguistic connections between various ethnic groups all across the world. articles.title: Marital_and_family_law_in_Kiravia
articles.snippet:
'''Marital and family law in Kiravia''' is rooted in Coscivian customary law, with influence from {{wp|canon law}}, as well as {{wp|Brehon law}} and {{wp|Sharia law|sharia}} in certain regions. As with Kiravian social policy overall, marital and family laws are the domain of individual states, territories, and other federal subjects, and consequently vary across jurisdictions in numerous points of detail.

Family law has not developed as a field distinct from civil law in Kiravia. However, many jurisdictions have specialised Courts of Wards, and a few high-population jurisdictions such as [[Escarda|County Dannen, Devahoma]] have specialised Courts of Marital Dissolution. [[Pribraltar]], an {{wp|associated state}} of the KF, does have a specialised lower court that approximates a Western family court, known as the Court of Divorce, Wardship, and Bastardy.

articles.title: Metzettan_Biphasic_Sleep_Schedule
articles.snippet:
Prior to the introduction of artificial, electric lighting in [[Metzetta]], interrupted sleep was dominant throughout the population. Thousands of references confirm that sleep was split into two phases; the first "dead sleep" and the second "morning sleep" which were separated by a period of approximately one hour known as "the watchful hour."

== Circadian Rhythm ==
The human circadian rhythm regulates sleep and wakefulness; it also controls the release of prolactin in the pituitary gland during the watchful hour which contributes to a feeling of peacefulness most associate with this time. While it may be considered "more natural" to engage in broken sleep it is not necessarily preferrable; studies have shown the newer uninterrupted sleep to be beneficial to both mental and physical wellbeing.

articles.title: Music_of_Metzetta
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
The '''Music of Metzetta''' comprises a wide variety of genres, both traditional and modern. [[Metzetta]] is one of the world's largest music markets, particularly with regards to physical media which it still embraces despite the popularity and wide availability of digital music and streaming services in the 21st century.
== Traditional and folk music ==
=== Chulcheo and music ===
The earliest extant forms of [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] music are vocal chants (sometimes accompanied by a simple drum) used in rituals of [[Chulcheo]] by priests.
[[File:Korean.Music-Janggu-01.jpg|thumb|Traditional marching drum]]
=== Gugak ===
Metzettan traditional music is referred to as gugak, which literally means "national music." It was often played in courts for the amusement of noblemen and royalty. Gugak often employed five-note scales (pentatonic scales, however with a different selection of notes from western scales of the same name) and standardised, syncopated rhythms.

articles.title: Ogonak
articles.snippet:
[[File:Ogonak.png|330px|thumb|Plated Ogonak at a restaurant]]
'''Ogonak''' is a traditional preserved meat product originating from the fatty tails of [[w:Sheep|sheep]], most commonly the [[Ogonram]] breed of north [[Audonia]]. It is a simple, long-lasting food that has been widely consumed across [[Nasastan]] for centuries, especially valued for its practicality, ease of preparation, and durability. Ogonak is a staple of everyday life in Nasastan. Its straightforward preparation and nutritional value reflect the Nasastani cultural preference for simplicity, a value deeply influenced by the region's [[Lakhe'žic]] traditions, which emphasize practicality and convenience. 

The word Ogonak comes from [[Pomorskitong]], combining ''ogon'' (tail) with the productive suffix ''-ak''. Ogonak is believed to have originated among the Mongol [[Chungus people|Chungus nomads]] of what is now eastern Nasastan. The current '''[[Metzetta|Metzettan]] Honours System''' began in 1860 with Emperor Daeku's reforms; he created The Order of The Magnolia Tree, The Order of The Sacred Lotus, the Imperial Medals of Honour, and formalised Metzetta's ancient peerage system.
== Current Orders ==
=== Supreme Order of Taeyang ===
Established in 2000 by Empress Joya as the premier order of [[Metzetta]]. Only a single class exists, the Grand Cordon. It is the highest possible honour that may be conferred. Normally awarded only to reigning Emperors and to foreign monarchs as a courtesy but may also be granted to extremely important government officials, Imperial Family members, certain non-royal foreign heads of state or high-ranking military personnel in rare instances. Taeyang is the Metzettan sun deity and supposed great-grandmother of [[Yang-jo|Emperor Yang-jo]], legendary founder of Metzetta. This order is always conferred by the [[Emperor of Metzetta|Emperor]] personally.

articles.title: Public_holidays_in_Urcea
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The following days are public holidays within [[Urcea]], divided into three classes of holidays. The three classes determine what level of observance is required, and was implemented in 1934 in order to decrease economic disruption. Holidays of the 1st Class, which include holy days of obligation among other holidays, are days in which the entire nation - with the exception of the [[Armed Forces of the Apostolic Kingdom of Urcea]] - is expected to observe. Holidays of the 2nd Class, which include major feast days, are primarily observed by employers in such a way that employees have a choice of which 2nd Class Holidays they will not work on, typically up to six per year (a figure ultimately determined by the industrial guild an employer is in). Holidays of the 3rd Class, which primarily include lesser civic holidays, are dependent upon guilds which vote to observe them, and on average each guild recognizes about three third class holidays. Religion_in_Pelaxia
articles.snippet:
'''Religion in Pelaxia''' is mostly Catholic, with 69.9% of the population belonging to the Catholic Church of Pelaxia in 2018. Judaism is the next largest religion  at 3.3%. The unaffiliated make up 17.4% of the population. Islam is followed by 3.0% of the population.

A bill passed in 2016 and intended to effectively make religious institutions in Pelaxia taxable by the government. This resolution was later found to be unconstitutional by the Federal Supreme Court in 2017. 

The Federal Republic is based on the principle of laicism enforced by the 1880s laws and the 1957 Constitution that establishes a “semi-separated” church-state relation, where the state pays a fraction of the Catholic Church salaries still to this day.

== Antiquity ==

articles.snippet:

'''Salajida''' (사라지다) is a [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] aesthetic ideal and philosophic concept relating to the ephemeral nature of existence, fleeting moments of beauty and the interconnectedness of all things. Present in all aspects of [[Culture of Metzetta|Metzettan culture]], it is one of [[Kanjin|Kanjin's]] four heavenly virtues alongside [[Geo-Ban]], [[Gwangye]] and [[Juinui Son]]. The world "salajida" is usually translated simply as "disappearing," alluding to its core tenet that nothing is permanent, all things constantly shift from one state to another even when appearing to remain the same, and moreover that comfort and beauty can be found in this fact. articles.title: Tanso
articles.snippet:
[[Category:IXWB]]
[[File:Danso, exposat a Eolssigu! Els sons de Corea.jpg|thumb|Bamboo tanso]]
The '''tanso''' (단소) is an end-blown flute often used in traditional [[Metzetta|Metzettan]] music. It was crafted from bamboo but in recent years plastic versions have been on the market. The tanso has four finger holes on the top and a thumb hole on the back. The playing range is 2 octaves, from low G to high G. It can be played solo or in a chamber ensemble. There is a larger version which plays lower notes known as the tungso.

The tanso declined in popularity during the 20th century as western-style music entered the country but has experienced a resurgence thanks in part to [[Shon Iksung|Shon Iksung's]] tanso pieces and a general desire amongst Metzettans to preserve their traditions in the face of increasing globalisation.

articles.title: Aventine_Downs
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
'''Aventine Downs''' is a gated residential community in the city of [[New Venceia]], [[Alexandria]]. Located in the city's [[Sagittaria Beach]] district, the neighborhood spans {{convert|400|ha|acre}} along Alexandria's northeastern coastline. It was developed by [[QV Properties]] of [[Caphiria]] and is one of the most expensive neighborhoods in [[Cartadania]], with homes often selling for at least [[Escudo|€]]7 million. Due to the upscale nature of the Sagittaria Beach district as a whole, the area often sees a lot of tourism, both domestic and international, and Aventine Downs is often the subject and setting of media and some films, similar to its neighboring sister community, [[Valerian Sands]].

articles.title: Burgophobia
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}
'''Anti-Burgoignesc sentiment''' or '''Burgophobia''' means opposition to, dislike of, fear of, or hatred towards [[Burgundie]] or [[Bergendii]] people. To a lesser extent, the term has also been applied to dislike of, fear of, or hatred towards [[Yonderre]] as well.

==Within Levantia==
===Dericania===
Burgophobia was particularly noteworthy during [[The Fraternal Wars]] in [[Dericania]]. Among [[Derian people]], the [[Bergendii]] gained a reputation for treachery and violence following the [[First Fratricide]]. It entered a sharp decline following the conclusion of the [[Second Great War]].

===Gothica===
Burgophobia within [[Gothica]] takes the form of anti-[[Yonderre]] sentiment and is common among Gothic nationalists. It was also somewhat common among [[Ænglish people]] in the late 19th century and is thought to have played a role in the unification of [[Avonia]].

articles.title: Dissolution_of_Varshan
articles.snippet:

The '''dissolution of Varshan''' unfolded throughout most of early [[2040]], as the [[Union of Varshan]] fractured along the lines of its constituent occupation-era zones into a set of independent successor states following a failed coup by the [[Army of the National Homeland]].

==Background== 
By the late 2030s, the Union of Varshan's federal structure — five constituent zones, each still shaped by the League of Nations occupying power that had originally administered it — had produced increasingly divergent political trajectories rather than a unified national identity. [[Zy'ita]] and [[Náyali]], the former Urcean and Cartadanian zones, had petitioned Urcean diplomats as early as 2025 about the possibility of seceding to join the [[Nysdra Sea Treaty Association]] outright, and were rebuffed each time on the grounds that Varshan's continued existence remained a priority for its principal guarantor. articles.title: Dragonnades
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}

The '''Dragonnades''' were a [[Holy Levantine Empire]] government policy instituted by the [[Leo III, Emperor of the Levantines|Emperor Leo III]] to intimidate Protestants in [[Levantia]] to convert to [[Catholic Church|Catholicism]] during the [[Great Confessional War]] by means of intimidation and force. Although the policy was originally limited to {{wp|Billet|quartering}} {{wp|Dragoon|dragoons}} in the homes of those suspected of religious non-compliance, it gradually escalated into a general allowance of government-sanctioned armed bands to unleash devestation in areas where Protestants lived. The policy culminated with the [[Holy League]]'s victory in the War and subsequent declaration of {{wp|outlaw}} status of all Protestants in the Empire on 10 August [[1575]]. With Protestants now living outside the protection of the law, their lives and property were forfeit, beginning a wave of major violence. articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}

The '''Drakrang''' ([[Hieratic Varshani]]: ''Hungry Time'') was a massive famine in [[Varshan]] that occurred from approximately [[2024]] to [[2027]], corresponding to the latter stages of the [[Final War of the Deluge]] and extending through the [[League-occupied Varshan|League of Nations occupation of the country]].

== Major causes ==
The decline and fall of [[Zurgite Varshan]] saw the destruction of its institutions - both deliberately and as a consequence of the war - which in turn led to the complete collapse of economic supply chains across Varshan and a complete disintegration of the country's internal market. As slavery was abolished in newly occupied territories, slaves working on farms typically abandoned the place of their bondage for displacement camps or cities controlled by the allies. articles.title: Enslaved_relative_scam
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''enslaved relative scam''' was a series of scams perpetrated by [[Zurgite Varshan]] during the [[1980]]s in order to attract [[Occidental]] technical experts to the country. The central part of the scam was Occidental individuals who were lost at sea in and around [[Crona]] or [[Vallos]] or otherwise disappeared under mysterious circumstances in those regions. Varshani intelligence would conduct research on the lost individuals, and if a close relative was considered to have expertise that would be useful - be it mechanical engineering, scientific, or otherwise - they would clandestinely reach out to the expert. Varshan would then tell the expert that their relative was not dead but had, in fact, been taken into slavery in Varshan. articles.title: Great_Landsmeet
articles.snippet: The '''Great Landsmeet''' was a socio-political institution in [[Urcea]] during the early history of Urcea. As a descendant of the [[Tribal Assembly (Great Levantia|Tribal Assembly]] of ancient [[Great Levantia]], it sat as the primary representative of the [[Estates of Urcea|estates of Urcea]] and served a quasi-legislative role in addition to being an advisory body for the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]]. It had the authority to approve or deny the levy of new taxes. The Landsmeet was first convened in 1022 and was envisioned as a way to mitigate disputes between the [[Estates of Urcea|estates of Urcea]] while also strengthening the rule of the [[Julian dynasty]] by implementing a kind of rule-by-consensus, an early example of later principles of the [[Constitution of Urcea]]. The Landsmeet only required the [[Optimate (Urcea)|optimate]] heads of Estates to convene as opposed to the earlier tribal assembly, making it a much more flexible institution to convene. articles.title: History_of_Varshan
articles.snippet:
{{Urcea WIP}}


The lands comprising modern Varshan were once inhabited by a variety of different Cronite peoples belonging to several different linguistic families. These peoples, most of which have been lost to history, were all tribally-organised until the early Cronite Bronze Age, when city-states began to develop in the region's fertile river valleys. The area now known as ''Umzàg'' or West-Central Varshan, emerged as the most heavily urbanized part of north central Crona, possibly as a result of its fertile volcanic soils and geographic circumscription by high mountain ranges.

'''Judeo-Protestantism''' describes a purported connection between {{wp|Protestantism}}, early Protestant reformers, and current Protestant practitioners and the {{wp|Jewish religion}}, particularly with regards to {{wp|sola scriptura}} and its focus on written traditions and their opposition to the [[Catholic Church]]. Judeo-Protestantism theories take a wide array of forms, but the most conventionally accepted one states that the party of the {{wp|Pharisees}} - the forbears of modern Judaism - were, in fact, the very first Protestants by means of their rejection of the salvific mission of {{wp|Jesus Christ}} and the authority of the {{wp|Apostles}}. Most theories describe relatively intricate lines of succession from the Pharisees - both implicit and explicit - through early Christian heretics and ending with the Protestant reformers. articles.title: Kurikiraptor
articles.snippet:
'''Kurikiraptor''', also known as '''Kurikisaurus''', was a species of dinosaur and one of the earliest discovered species of both the ''Dromaeosauridae'' family and the ''Deinonychosauria'' clade. It is named for Lake Kurik, in [[Faneria]]. Its remains can be found across northern Levantia in large numbers, as it appears to have been a very successful species. It is one of two members of the ''Homipullus'' genus, the other being [[Caedoraptor]]; while it is similar in build to the more populous species of the ''Serraspinus'' genus, it is believed to share an undiscovered common ancestor with Caedoraptor. {{Short description|Genus of small dromaeosaurid dinosaur}} {{Automatic taxobox | fossil_range = {{wpl|Early Cretaceous}}

articles.title: Passa_Óirthir
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

'''Passa Óirthir''' is a mountain pass in northeastern [[Urcea]] which crosses the [[Ionian Mountains]] in the province of [[Orival]]. It and the [[Belioné]] are the only passes through the Ionians below 1000 meters in elevation in northern [[Urcea]]. Unlike the Belioné, Passa Óirthir was largely unsuitable in premodern times for sustaining a direct trade route in part due to steep rises in elevation along the length of the pass. The eastern opening is an extended downward sloping plateau far from any river system, making the west-to-east journey lengthy and requiring additional supplies. Passa Óirthir was only regularly used to reach areas on the far upper portions of the [[Farax River]]. It saw more extensive use as a passage for raiders and armed forces, and even then before the Passa Óirthir Railroad was established it could only support small numbers of armed forces. The railroad was constructed in the late 1850s and early 1860s, connecting [[Killdaire]] to [[Carinella]]

articles.title: Pharisedom
articles.snippet:
{{wip}}

'''Pharisedoms''', also referred to as '''Lands of Refuge''', are polities, territories, and regions settled by [[Levantia|Levantine]] {{wp|Protestants}} following their expulsion from the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] and adjoining territories in the decades following the [[Great Confessional War]]. Pharisedoms are home to the majority of the world's Protestant population. There are varying types of these entities, ranging from deliberately created lands abroad for Protestants to former penal colonies. While many Pharisedoms are independent states, many - like [[Medimeria]] - remained within the political orbit of [[Levantia]] and today enjoy degrees of autonomy.

==Etymology==
The term "Pharisedom" is derived from the word {{wp|pharisee}}, a derogatory term used in [[Levantia]] referring to Protestants. It entered common usage in both [[Urcea]] and [[Dericania]] during the 17th century describing Protestant settlements in [[Crona]], and over time the term became generalized desc

articles.title: Plantatía
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Plantatía''' ("Plantation", plural "Plantatíar") was a [[Urcea]]n unit of government created to hold jurisdiction over areas in the Urcean periphery of [[Levantia]], particularly those settled by [[Ómestaderoi]] specifically or by [[Riparians]] generally. The system was created in the Leonine Land Decree of [[1590]] and subsequently clarified. This included lands conquered or incorporated into Urcea as well as areas within Urcea made settleable by means of internal improvements such as reservoirs or draining. When created, Plantatíar would not replace the local feudal-era duchy or county but would instead supersede it in some regards, particularly as it related to the management and organization of multiple settler towns and administration of justice to people living therein. Interaction with the older heredtiary constituencies became political rather than feudal in nature as the settlers [[Land_ownership_in_Urcea#Freehold|typically held their land in their own name]]

articles.title: Recess_of_the_Julii
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Recess of the [[Julian dynasty|Julii]]''' is a historiographical term referring to the period from approximately [[1815]] to [[1902]] during which [[Urcea]] did not participate in the institutions of the [[Holy Levantine Empire]] from both an administrative and geopolitical point of view. The antagonism between the two entities began in earnest with the [[Second Caroline War]], when Urcea was forced to cede the [[Grand Duchy of Carolina]] and the [[Apostolic King of Urcea]] was forced to surrender his claim on the title of [[Emperor of the Levantines]] which had been secured after the [[War of the Caroline Succession]]. The traditionally understood beginning of the Recess occurred in 1815, when King Niall V received permission from the [[Pope]] to expel the [[Imperial Inquisition]] - an institution with both religious and law enforcement prerogatives - from Urcea and replacing it with the new office of [[Censor (Urcea)|Censor]], a move with both practical and symbolic

articles.title: Royal_Treasury_(Urcea)
articles.snippet:
{{stub}}

The '''Royal Treasury''' of [[Urcea]] is the primary organ of the [[Government of Urcea]] within the [[Constitution of Urcea|Urcean constitution]]. The Treasury is not a distinct institution as such, but refers functionally to the entire government, which allocates, receives, disburses, and spends funds. The beginnings of the Urcean government lay in the creation of the [[Conshilía Daoni]] under the authority of the [[Procurator]] - the Royal Steward - in [[1146]] and the subsequent inclusion of the [[Conshilía Purpháidhe]] under the Procurator in the late medieval period. Consequently, most elected officials on the national level are considered to be officers of the treasury, including all members of the Daoni.
